entries.title: 超越缺陷检测：X 射线与 CT 在现代无损检测中的作用
entries.title_en: Beyond Defect Detection: The Role of X-ray and CT in Modern Non-Destructive Testing
entries.summary: Dragonfly 官方博客介绍工业 X 射线与 CT 如何结合三维图像分析定位、测量缺陷（孔隙、裂纹、焊点），并展示 Dragonfly 3D World 2027 的实例分割（Grid-Based SAM、Cellpose-SAM）、多网格测量、STEP/CAD 偏差图、粗糙度测量和报告生成器。
entries.summary_en: The official Dragonfly blog explains how industrial X-ray and CT combined with 3D image analysis locate and measure defects (porosity, cracks, solder joints), showcasing Dragonfly 3D World 2027 instance segmentation (Grid-Based SAM, Cellpose-SAM), multi-mesh measurements, STEP/CAD deviation maps, roughness measurement and Report Builder.
entries.source: Dragonfly 官方博客（Comet Technologies Canada，Alexandra Sakellariou）
entries.source_en: Dragonfly official blog (Comet Technologies Canada, Alexandra Sakellariou)

entries.title: 古埃及猫木乃伊 µCT 研究的配套数据集：Dragonfly 训练的分割神经网络
entries.title_en: Trained neural networks and slice analysis material for 'The life and afterlife of an ancient Egyptian cat reconstructed by µCT'
entries.summary: 麦吉尔大学一篇生物考古论文的配套数据集：用 Dragonfly 3D World 2025.1 训练的神经网络对四只猫标本的 micro-CT 重建进行分割，并附 Dragonfly 团队预训练的 2.5D U-Net 模型。
entries.summary_en: Supplementary dataset from McGill University for a bioarchaeology manuscript: neural networks trained in Dragonfly 3D World 2025.1 segment micro-CT reconstructions of four cat specimens, plus a pre-trained 2.5D U-Net from the Dragonfly team.
entries.source_en: Zenodo (dataset; Demers-Potvin, Jia, Reznikov, McGill University)

entries.title: 木材–塑料复合材料（WPC）中纤维与基体相互作用的研究
entries.title_en: Investigations into the interaction between fibrous elements and matrix in wood–plastic composite (WPC)
entries.summary: 卢布尔雅那大学（与吕勒奥理工大学合作）的硕士论文用 Zeiss Xradia 620 Versa micro-CT 以 0.73 µm 体素对木塑复合材料成像，并用 Comet Technologies Canada 的 Dragonfly 软件分析纤维与基体的相互作用。
entries.summary_en: A University of Ljubljana master's thesis (with Luleå University of Technology) imaged wood–plastic composites on a Zeiss Xradia 620 Versa micro-CT at 0.73 µm voxel size and analysed the fibre–matrix interaction with Comet Technologies Canada's Dragonfly software.
entries.source: 卢布尔雅那大学知识库（硕士论文，Alexander Simić）
entries.source_en: University of Ljubljana Repository (M.Sc. thesis, Alexander Simić)

entries.title: 胰腺组织与胰岛分割模型的同步辐射 X 射线数据集（人类非糖尿病与糖尿病）
entries.title_en: Synchrotron X-ray Data of non-diseased and diabetic Human Pancreas Tissue and Islet Segmentation Models
entries.summary: EMBL 汉堡、海德堡大学等团队公开了 32 人 55 个人胰腺组织芯的同步辐射 micro-CT 虚拟组织学数据集（650 nm 体素），胰岛标注用 Dragonfly 3D World v2025.1（Comet Technologies Canada）内置 SAM2 与标注工具完成，并在 Segmentation Wizard 训练 2.5D U-Net 胰岛分割模型，模型随数据一起发布、可在 Dragonfly 3D World 中复用。
entries.summary_en: An open synchrotron micro-CT dataset of human pancreas tissue; islet annotations were made with SAM2 and annotation tools in Dragonfly 3D World v2025.1, and dataset-specific 2.5D U-Net models trained in its Segmentation Wizard are released for reuse in Dragonfly.
entries.source: Scientific Data · EMBL 汉堡 / 海德堡大学等
entries.source_en: Scientific Data · EMBL Hamburg / Heidelberg University and collaborators

entries.title: 隐孢子虫的有性生殖拥有复杂的雄性受精装置，是持续感染所必需的
entries.title_en: Cryptosporidium sex employs a complex male fertilization apparatus that is required for continued infection
entries.summary: 宾夕法尼亚大学 Striepen 团队与罗伯特·科赫研究所发现隐孢子虫雄配子的复杂受精装置，并证明敲除 HAP2 可阻断受精、治愈感染小鼠；小鼠肠道的连续块面扫描电镜（SBF-SEM）图像栈用 Fiji 或 Dragonfly 3D World v2025.1（Comet Technologies Canada）做配准、AI 去噪和滤波处理。
entries.summary_en: Serial block-face SEM stacks of infected mouse intestine were registered, AI-denoised and filtered in Fiji or Dragonfly 3D World v2025.1 in this study of the Cryptosporidium male fertilization apparatus.
entries.source: bioRxiv（预印本）· 宾夕法尼亚大学 / 罗伯特·科赫研究所
entries.source_en: bioRxiv (preprint) · University of Pennsylvania / Robert Koch Institute

entries.title: 含毫米级裂纹浅层黄土的初始破坏形态：工业 CT 三维成像
entries.title_en: Initial failure morphology of shallow loess containing millimeter-scale cracks: Insights from CT 3d imaging
entries.summary: 广东工业大学赵璐清、周翠英与长安大学彭建兵等用工业 CT 研究含人工毫米级裂纹黄土试样的初始破坏形态。预处理后的 CT 图像在 Dragonfly（Comet Technologies Canada）中做三维重建；再用软件内高度封装的 2.5D U-Net 插件（5 层编码器–解码器、初始 64 个滤波器、三连续切片输入、64×64 补丁、Ors Dice Loss、Adadelta 优化、训练 100 步）分割黄土基质、裂纹和孔隙。
entries.summary_en: Luqing Zhao and Cuiying Zhou at Guangdong University of Technology, with Jianbing Peng at Chang'an University and colleagues, used industrial CT to study the initial failure morphology of loess specimens containing artificial millimeter-scale cracks. After pre-processing, three-dimensional reconstructions were generated in Dragonfly (Comet Technologies Canada). A highly encapsulated 2.5D U-Net plugin in the software (5-layer encoder–decoder, 64 initial filters, three consecutive input slices, 64×64 patches, Ors Dice Loss, Adadelta, 100 training steps) was trained to separate loess matrix, cracks and pores.
entries.source: PLoS ONE · 广东工业大学 / 长安大学
entries.source_en: PLoS ONE · Guangdong University of Technology / Chang'an University

entries.title: Tau 单体与纤维通过不同细胞机制逃逸小胶质细胞清除
entries.title_en: Tau monomers and fibrils escape microglial clearance via distinct cellular mechanisms
entries.summary: Genentech 等研究 tau 单体与纤维逃逸人源诱导多能干细胞来源小胶质细胞清除的不同机制。断层分割与可视化使用 DragonFly（https://dragonfly.comet.tech）：先滤波增强对比并手动标注二维补丁，建立一个通用模型后再对每个断层微调，分割结果导出到 ChimeraX，断层切片则用 IMOD 显示。
entries.summary_en: Researchers at Genentech and collaborators study how tau monomers and fibrils escape clearance by human iPSC-derived microglia through distinct cellular mechanisms. Tomogram segmentation was performed in DragonFly (https://dragonfly.comet.tech): tomograms were filtered to enhance contrast for manual annotation of two-dimensional patches, an initial universal model was trained and then retrained on each tomogram, and segmentations were exported to ChimeraX, with tomographic slices visualized in IMOD.
entries.source_en: Nature Cell Biology · Genentech and collaborators

entries.title: 增材合金内部型腔的 X 射线 CT 与三坐标测量基准数据集
entries.title_en: X-ray tomography and coordinate metrology benchmark for internal cavities in additively manufactured alloys
entries.summary: 蒙特利尔高等技术学校（ETS）、蒙特利尔综合理工与 Comet Technologies Canada 的 Eric Fournier 合作，发布增材制造 Ti-6Al-4V 和 Inconel 625 内部型腔的 CT–三坐标测量机（CMM）壁厚基准，覆盖毛坯和化学铣削四种情形。基准 CT 表面分割在 Dragonfly 3D World 2025.1 中生成；其中一条深度学习路线使用随该版本发布的专有权重 U-Net 类模型。代码可用性声明写明 CT 重建用 CERA、表面分割用 Dragonfly 3D World 2025.1，软件可从 https://dragonfly.comet.tech/ 获取，符合条件的非商业学术用户可申请免费学术许可。
entries.summary_en: Researchers at ÉTS, Polytechnique Montréal and Eric Fournier of Comet Technologies Canada release a CT–CMM wall-thickness benchmark for internal cavities in additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V and Inconel 625, covering rough and chemically milled states. Benchmark CT surfaces were segmented in Dragonfly 3D World 2025.1; a deep-learning route uses a U-Net-like model with proprietary weights released as part of that version. The code-availability statement says reconstructions were generated in CERA and surface segmentations in Dragonfly 3D World 2025.1, available at https://dragonfly.comet.tech/; eligible non-commercial academic users may apply for a free academic licence.
entries.source: Research Square（预印本）· 蒙特利尔高等技术学校 / 蒙特利尔综合理工 / Comet Technologies Canada
entries.source_en: Research Square (preprint) · École de technologie supérieure / Polytechnique Montréal / Comet Technologies Canada

entries.title: 用三维冷冻体积电镜观察并定量光合丝状蓝藻鱼腥藻
entries.title_en: The Application of 3D Cryo-Volume Electron Microscopy to Visualize and Quantify the Photosynthetic Filamentous Cyanobacterium Anabaena
entries.summary: 丹佛斯植物科学中心 Czymmek 团队用 Thermo Scientific Hydra 等离子聚焦离子束扫描电镜（氩离子铣削与透过透镜探测器成像交替）对两种丝状蓝藻鱼腥藻做整细胞冷冻体积电镜成像。对齐后的图像导入 Dragonfly 3D World 2024.1（Comet Technologies Canada Inc., Montreal）做分割：用 multi-slice pen 手动分割羧酶体、藻青素颗粒和细胞壁，再用 Segmentation Wizard 中预训练的 2.5D（3 切片）U-Net Depth 5 模型（2024.1 与 2025.1）分割类囊体/藻胆体和多聚磷酸盐颗粒；随后把结构转为 multi-ROI 测量体积，用线测量工具测量类囊体厚度与间距，并用 2D animation 与 Movie Maker 导出三维视频。
entries.summary_en: A team led by Czymmek at the Donald Danforth Plant Science Center imaged whole cells of two filamentous Anabaena species by cryo-volume electron microscopy on a Thermo Scientific Hydra plasma FIB-SEM, alternating argon milling with through-lens detector imaging. Aligned stacks were imported into Dragonfly 3D World 2024.1 (Comet Technologies Canada Inc., Montreal): carboxysomes, cyanophycin granules and cell walls were segmented manually with the multi-slice pen, while thylakoids/phycobilisomes and polyphosphate granules were segmented with the pre-trained 2.5D (3-slice) U-Net Depth 5 model in Segmentation Wizard (2024.1 and 2025.1). Structures were converted to a multi-ROI for volume measurements, thylakoid thickness and spacing were taken with the line-measurement tool, and 3D videos were exported with 2D animation and Movie Maker.
entries.source: bioRxiv（预印本）· 丹佛斯植物科学中心
entries.source_en: bioRxiv (preprint) · Donald Danforth Plant Science Center

entries.title: 全增材堆叠实现可扩展的四层再布线层：无缺陷多层集成演示
entries.title_en: Scalable Four-Layer Redistribution Layers via Fully Additive Build-Up: Demonstration of Defect-Free Multilayer Integration
entries.summary: 瑞典吕勒奥理工大学 Roghayeh Imani、Shailesh Chouhan 和 Jerker Delsing 演示用全增材 Sequential Build-Up Covalent Bonded Metallization（SBU-CBM）工艺在 FR-4 基板上制作四层铜再布线层（RDL），层间以三个交错微孔相连。多层结构的三维表征使用该校的 Zeiss Xradia 620 Versa XCT（20×物镜，80 kV、10 W，LE3 滤波）；三维重建与可视化使用非商业版 Dragonfly software（Object Research Systems, Montreal, Canada）。
entries.summary_en: Roghayeh Imani, Shailesh Chouhan and Jerker Delsing at Luleå University of Technology demonstrate a four-layer copper redistribution-layer (RDL) stack on FR-4 made with the fully additive Sequential Build-Up Covalent Bonded Metallization (SBU-CBM) process, with three staggered microvias. Three-dimensional characterization used a Zeiss Xradia 620 Versa XCT at LTU (20× objective, 80 kV and 10 W, LE3 filter); reconstruction and visualization were performed with the non-commercial version of Dragonfly software (Object Research Systems, Montreal, Canada).
entries.source: IMAPSource Proceedings · 瑞典吕勒奥理工大学
entries.source_en: IMAPSource Proceedings · Luleå University of Technology

entries.title: 材料诱导的纤维连接蛋白组装使低剂量 BMP-2 能在临界负重骨缺损中再生结构成熟的骨
entries.title_en: Material-driven fibronectin assembly enables low-dose BMP-2 to regenerate structurally mature bone in critical-sized load-bearing defects
entries.summary: 格拉斯哥大学细胞微环境中心等团队用实验室 micro-CT（螺旋扫描，80 kV、69 µA，体素 2 µm）量化 monetite 支架在临界负重骨缺损中的降解、孔隙与成骨。图像重建与三维渲染在 ORS Dragonfly 2022.2（Object Research Systems Inc, Montreal, CA）中完成；团队用自定义深度学习模型（至少手动标注 15 张代表性二维切片）自动分割新生骨、monetite 体积和孔隙，计算缺损区和支架邻近区的骨体积分数（BV/TV），并用分割工具量化骨–支架整合。
entries.summary_en: A team including the Centre for the Cellular Microenvironment at the University of Glasgow used laboratory micro-CT (helical scans at 80 kV and 69 µA, 2 µm voxels) to quantify degradation, porosity and bone formation of monetite scaffolds in critical-sized load-bearing defects. Images were reconstructed and rendered in ORS Dragonfly 2022.2 (Object Research Systems Inc, Montreal, CA). Custom deep-learning models, trained on at least 15 manually labelled representative 2D slices, automatically segmented newly formed bone, monetite volume and porosity; bone volume fraction (BV/TV) was calculated in the defect and in the immediate monetite vicinity, and bone–scaffold integration was quantified with the software’s segmentation tools.
entries.source: bioRxiv（预印本）· 格拉斯哥大学等
entries.source_en: bioRxiv (preprint) · University of Glasgow and collaborators

entries.title: 用冷冻电子断层扫描定位小鼠海马突触的 AMPA 与 NMDA 受体
entries.title_en: Mapping AMPA and NMDA receptors at mouse brain hippocampal synapses by cryo-ET
entries.summary: Cathy J. Spangler、Eric Gouaux 等用来自马萨诸塞大学陈医学院与俄勒冈健康与科学大学的冷冻电子断层扫描，定位成年小鼠海马突触的 AMPA 与 NMDA 受体。方法写明，需要展示时，actin 和突触后致密物（PSD）特征在 Dragonfly version 2025.1 中手动分割。
entries.summary_en: Cathy J. Spangler, Eric Gouaux and colleagues at UMass Chan Medical School and Oregon Health & Science University map AMPA and NMDA receptors at adult mouse hippocampal synapses by cryo-electron tomography. The methods state that actin and postsynaptic-density (PSD) features were segmented manually in Dragonfly version 2025.1 when shown.
entries.source: bioRxiv（预印本）· 马萨诸塞大学陈医学院 / 俄勒冈健康与科学大学
entries.source_en: bioRxiv (preprint) · UMass Chan Medical School / Oregon Health & Science University

entries.title: 用物理信息神经网络推导接近 Hashin–Shtrikman 刚度极限的新型各向同性超材料
entries.title_en: Derivation of Novel Isotropic Metamaterials at the Hashin-Shtrikman Stiffness Limit Enabled by Physics Informed Neural Networks
entries.summary: 南洋理工大学 Lai 组用物理信息神经网络设计接近 Hashin–Shtrikman 刚度极限的各向同性闭孔板格超材料，并以 Zeiss Xradia Versa 620（0.4×物镜，160 kV，25 W，每投影曝光 1 s，各向同性体素 15.5 µm）对增材制造样品做 micro-CT，重建使用 Dragonfly 3D World ZEISS software。
entries.summary_en: Lai and colleagues at Nanyang Technological University use physics-informed neural networks to design isotropic closed-cell plate-lattice metamaterials near the Hashin–Shtrikman stiffness limit. Additively manufactured samples were scanned on a Zeiss Xradia Versa 620 (0.4× objective, 160 kV, 25 W, 1 s per projection, 15.5 µm isotropic voxels) and reconstructed with Dragonfly 3D World ZEISS software.

entries.title: 密螺旋体鞭毛曲率生成与功能特化的结构基础
entries.title_en: Structural basis for curvature generation and functional specialization in spirochete flagella
entries.summary: Ghosal 等在 Nature Communications 报道密螺旋体鞭毛曲率生成与功能特化的结构基础。匹配的 bioRxiv 预印本（10.64898/2026.02.04.703737）写明：三维体数据用 Dragonfly software（version 2022.2）分割（文献指向 https://dragonfly.comet.tech/），导入后用内置滤波提高清晰度，手动标注 15–20 张切片训练 2.5D U-Net（5 切片输入），再经迭代训练与必要的手工修正完成分割，并用软件内置功能生成二维图和三维视频。
entries.summary_en: Ghosal and colleagues report in Nature Communications the structural basis for curvature generation and functional specialization in spirochete flagella. The matching bioRxiv preprint (10.64898/2026.02.04.703737) states that 3D volumes were segmented in Dragonfly software (version 2022.2), cited to https://dragonfly.comet.tech/: tomograms were filtered after import, 15–20 slices were manually annotated to train a 2.5D U-Net (5-slice input), models were applied after iterative training with manual corrections where needed, and built-in functions generated 2D images and 3D movies.

entries.title: 熊蜂嗅觉系统的性二态在不同物种间保守
entries.title_en: Sexual dimorphisms of the olfactory system are conserved across bumblebee species
entries.summary: 杜伦大学等团队比较了 6 种欧洲熊蜂野外工蜂和雄蜂的大脑与触角。共聚焦成像的触角叶和全脑在 Dragonfly 3D World（Object Research Systems）中分割：用 ROI Painter 的 Freehand Region 手工勾画每个嗅小球的起止和中部，再以 Z 向插值补全，约 20 个嗅小球后合并为 Multi-ROI，全部完成后用布尔运算 Union 合并，并以 Labeled Class Count 和 Connected Components 分析计数嗅小球并测量体积；全脑体积则用阈值分割加形态学闭运算与平滑得到。结果显示这些物种间嗅觉系统的雌雄差异是保守的。
entries.summary_en: A team led from Durham University compared brains and antennae of wild workers and males from six European Bombus species. Confocal stacks of antennal lobes and whole brains were segmented in Dragonfly 3D World (Object Research Systems): each glomerulus was outlined at its start, middle and end with the Freehand Region tool in ROI Painter, completed by Z-interpolation, merged into a Multi-ROI after about 20 glomeruli, then combined with a Boolean Union so glomeruli could be counted (Labeled Class Count) and measured (Connected Components). Whole-brain volume was obtained by thresholding plus morphological close and smooth. The sexual dimorphisms of the olfactory system turned out to be conserved across these species.

entries.title: 热压罐与真空烘箱固化亚麻/环氧复合材料 I 型分层中的损伤机制与断裂过程区演化
entries.title_en: Damage mechanisms and fracture-process-zone evolution during Mode I delamination of autoclave- and vacuum-assisted oven-cured flax/epoxy composites
entries.summary: 芬兰 LUT 大学与卢布尔雅那大学团队比较热压罐和真空辅助烘箱两种工艺固化的亚麻/环氧层合板，结合双悬臂梁（DCB）试验、数字图像相关、声发射和 X 射线 CT（Zeiss Xradia MicroXCT-400）研究 I 型分层。CT 数据在 Dragonfly 2025 中分割，并按位置把孔隙分为纤维腔内腔、纤维间/束间孔隙和纤维–基体界面孔洞三类，用来把孔隙率与分层阻力联系起来。
entries.summary_en: Teams from LUT University (Finland) and the University of Ljubljana compared flax/epoxy laminates cured in an autoclave and in a vacuum-assisted oven, combining double cantilever beam (DCB) tests, digital image correlation, acoustic emission and X-ray CT (Zeiss Xradia MicroXCT-400) to study Mode I delamination. Segmentation in Dragonfly 2025 classified voids by location as intra-fibre lumen cavities, inter-fibre/inter-bundle pores and fibre–matrix interfacial voids, so porosity could be related to delamination resistance.
entries.source: Composites Part A: Applied Science and Manufacturing
entries.source_en: Composites Part A: Applied Science and Manufacturing

entries.title: 可降解镁锌丝中的稀释锌合金化：显微组织、力学性能与降解行为
entries.title_en: Dilute Zn alloying in biodegradable Mg wires: microstructure, mechanical performance, and degradation behavior
entries.summary: 研究用直接热挤压制备 Mg-0.4Zn 至 Mg-1.5Zn 可降解镁丝，并比较显微组织、力学性能和降解行为。腐蚀前丝材横截面的三维可视化及颗粒体积分析在 Zeiss Xradia 610 Versa（体素 470 nm）上完成，采集的数据用 Dragonfly software（v. 2025.1）处理：以直方图分割区分丝材、颗粒和背景，再经目视检查后测定颗粒相对丝材的体积分数。
entries.summary_en: Dilute Mg–Zn wires (0.4–1.5 wt% Zn) made by direct hot extrusion were compared for microstructure, mechanical performance and degradation. Three-dimensional visualization of the wire cross-section before etching, together with volumetric analysis of particles, was performed on a Zeiss Xradia 610 Versa (470 nm voxels); the data were processed in Dragonfly software (v. 2025.1) by histogram segmentation of wire, particles and background, followed by visual inspection and measurement of the particle volume fraction relative to the wire.

entries.title: 早寒武世微生物伪形态中的软躯体化石揭示分节两侧对称动物的黎明
entries.title_en: Dawn of segmented bilaterians unveiled by soft-bodied fossils in microbial pseudomorphs from the early Cambrian
entries.summary: 杨晓光、韩健等报道早寒武世以微生物伪形态保存的分节两侧对称动物软躯体化石。X 射线显微层析数据（含西北大学大陆动力学国家重点实验室，以及日本 SPring-8 对标本 XX59-71 的扫描：23 keV，0.49 µm 各向同性体素）用 Dragonfly 3.5 software 做层析分析并制作三维可视化图片和视频。匹配的 bioRxiv 预印本为 10.64898/2026.06.18.733126。
entries.summary_en: Xiaoguang Yang, Jian Han and colleagues report early Cambrian soft-bodied fossils of segmented bilaterians preserved as microbial pseudomorphs. X-ray microtomography data—including scans at the State Key Laboratory of Continental Dynamics, Northwest University, and one specimen (XX59-71) at SPring-8 in Japan (23 keV, 0.49 µm isotropic voxels)—were processed in Dragonfly 3.5 software for tomographic analysis and for making three-dimensional visualization pictures and videos. The matching bioRxiv preprint is 10.64898/2026.06.18.733126.
entries.source: eLife（reviewed preprint）· 杨晓光、韩健等
entries.source_en: eLife (reviewed preprint) · Xiaoguang Yang, Jian Han and colleagues

entries.title: Dragonfly Notebook：在 Dragonfly 里直接运行 Jupyter 笔记本的开源插件
entries.title_en: Dragonfly Notebook: an open-source plugin for running Jupyter-style notebooks inside Dragonfly
entries.summary: Marius Didziokas 在 GitHub 以 MIT 许可证开源了 Dragonfly Notebook 插件，可在 Dragonfly 里以 Jupyter 方式运行 Python 单元：把通道、ROI 和 MultiROI 作为 numpy 数组导入，再把结果作为 Dragonfly 对象发布回场景，并能读写分割结果的测量属性。笔记本在独立进程和自带的 IPython 内核中运行，执行时 Dragonfly 界面不卡顿，支持停止按钮和实时输出；文件为标准 .ipynb，可选独立 Python 环境并用 pip 安装包。目前要求 Windows 上的 Dragonfly 2025.1，安装后在 Utilities > Plugins 菜单中启动。
entries.summary_en: Marius Didziokas has released Dragonfly Notebook on GitHub under the MIT licence, letting users run Jupyter-style Python cells inside Dragonfly: channels, ROIs and MultiROIs are imported as numpy arrays, results are published back to the scene as Dragonfly objects, and measured properties of a segmentation can be read and written. The notebook runs in its own process with a private IPython kernel, so the Dragonfly GUI stays responsive with a Stop button and live output; files are plain .ipynb, and optional private Python environments support pip installs. It currently requires Dragonfly 2025.1 on Windows and is launched from Utilities > Plugins after installation.

entries.title: 从显微图像到可测量的三维结构：Dragonfly 3D World ZEISS 版介绍
entries.title_en: From Microscopy Images to Measurable 3D Structures
entries.summary: CMM Quarterly 的 Mark Boucher 撰文介绍 Dragonfly 3D World ZEISS 版如何处理 X 射线显微镜和 FIB-SEM 等 2D、3D 及时间序列数据：体渲染与多平面视图、不同尺度数据的配准和拼接，滤波、阈值、形态学等图像处理和机器学习分割，可选的深度学习模块，以及体积、表面积、孔隙率、连通性和迂曲度等定量测量，并支持用 Python（NumPy、SciPy）编写脚本实现可重复流程。文中也提醒，结果仍取决于扫描质量和分割是否可靠。
entries.summary_en: Mark Boucher of CMM Quarterly explains how Dragonfly 3D World ZEISS edition handles 2D, 3D and time-dependent data from X-ray microscopy and FIB-SEM: volume rendering and multiplanar views, registering and stitching data from different scales, filtering, thresholding, morphology and machine-learning segmentation, an optional deep-learning module, and measurements such as volume, surface area, porosity, connectivity and tortuosity, with Python scripting (NumPy, SciPy) for repeatable workflows. The article notes that results still depend on scan quality and reliable segmentation.

entries.title: 【Dragonfly】3D 图像数据从读入到保存：三维图像分析基本操作（日语视频）
entries.title_en: Dragonfly basics: from loading to saving 3D image data (Japanese video)
entries.summary: 日本 MAXNET（株式会社マックスネット）频道发布的约 5 分钟日语入门视频，以 Dragonfly 2027.1 演示三维图像数据从读入到保存的基本流程：界面的看法、显示操作、亮度调整和裁剪所需区域，面向第一次使用的用户。
entries.summary_en: A roughly five-minute Japanese tutorial from the MAXNET channel (Imaging Compass) that walks first-time users through the basic Dragonfly 2027.1 workflow from loading to saving 3D image data: reading the interface, display controls, brightness adjustment and cropping the region of interest.

entries.title: 序贯螯合、连续螯合与 Triton® 一体化冲洗方案清除根管内堆积硬组织碎屑的效果比较：一项 micro-CT 研究
entries.title_en: Comparative Efficacy of Sequential Chelation, Continuous Chelation, and Triton® All-In-One Irrigation Protocols for Removing Accumulated Hard-Tissue Debris: A Micro-CT Study
entries.summary: 研究用 36 颗离体单根管人牙，平均分成三组，分别用 NaOCl 后接 EDTA、Triton® All-In-One、NaOCl 混合 Dual Rinse® HEDP 冲洗，根管预备前后各做一次 micro-CT（各向同性 8.92 µm）。前后数据导入 Dragonfly 3D World（Comet Technologies Canada）做三维配准，再用半自动分割和专用阈值区分根管空间、牙本质和堆积的硬组织碎屑并计算体积。三组残留碎屑中位体积分别为 0.38、0.41 和 0.31 mm³，差异无统计学意义，没有一种方案能完全避免碎屑堆积。
entries.summary_en: Thirty-six extracted single-canal human teeth were split into three groups irrigated with NaOCl followed by EDTA, Triton® All-In-One, or NaOCl mixed with Dual Rinse® HEDP, with micro-CT scans (8.92 µm isotropic) before and after canal preparation. Pre- and post-treatment datasets were registered in 3D in Dragonfly 3D World (Comet Technologies Canada), and canal space, dentin and accumulated hard-tissue debris were separated by semiautomated segmentation with dedicated thresholds to compute volumes. Median residual debris volumes were 0.38, 0.41 and 0.31 mm³; the differences were not significant, and no protocol fully prevented debris accumulation.

entries.title: 四足动物头骨简化：一项宏观演化研究（柏林洪堡大学博士论文）
entries.title_en: Skull Simplification in Tetrapoda: A Macroevolutionary Approach (HU Berlin doctoral thesis)
entries.summary: Kim Julia Kean 的柏林洪堡大学博士论文研究四足动物演化中头骨顶部骨块的减少与愈合。其中一章挑选 16 件早期四足动物化石（离片椎类和壳椎类），先在柏林自然博物馆用 Comet YXLON FF85 做 CT 扫描，再到欧洲同步辐射装置（ESRF）BM05 线站做相衬同步辐射 micro-CT，重点扫描颞区等最可能发生骨缝愈合的部位；CT 和同步辐射数据都在 Dragonfly 3D World 2024.1（Comet Technologies Canada）中做可视化分析。
entries.summary_en: Kim Julia Kean's doctoral thesis at Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin examines the loss and fusion of skull-roof bones across tetrapod evolution. One chapter selects 16 early tetrapod fossils (temnospondyls and lepospondyls), CT-scans them on a Comet YXLON FF85 at the Museum für Naturkunde Berlin and then by propagation phase-contrast synchrotron micro-CT at ESRF beamline BM05, focusing on regions such as the temporal series where suture closure is most likely; both CT and synchrotron data were visualised in Dragonfly 3D World 2024.1 (Comet Technologies Canada).
entries.source: 柏林洪堡大学 edoc 文献库（博士论文）
entries.source_en: Humboldt-Universität zu Berlin edoc server (doctoral thesis)

entries.title: 冻结颗粒堆积体内部：颗粒、冰和空气的三维 micro-CT 视频
entries.title_en: Inside a Frozen Particle Packing: Particles, Ice and Air in 3D (Micro-CT)
entries.summary: Amirali Khosrozadeh 发布的 YouTube 视频：一份冻结的玻璃珠堆积体经 X 射线 micro-CT 扫描后在 Dragonfly 中分割和标记，重建结果分出三相：把样品粘结在一起的冰、每一颗玻璃珠，以及困在小孔隙里的空气。视频说明，冻结颗粒材料中固体颗粒、冰和空气同时存在并相互作用，研究其变形、融化和破坏需要耦合固体力学、传热和相变的多物理场模拟。
entries.summary_en: A YouTube video by Amirali Khosrozadeh: a frozen packing of glass beads scanned with X-ray micro-CT and segmented and labelled in Dragonfly, separating three phases: the ice that bonds the sample, every individual glass bead, and the air trapped in small pores. The video notes that solid particles, ice and air coexist and interact in frozen granular materials, so studying how they deform, melt and break calls for multiphysics simulation coupling solid mechanics, heat transfer and phase change.

entries.title: 咬合面起伏和牙齿磨耗可预测圈养狒狒的髓腔体积
entries.title_en: Occlusal Relief and Dental Wear Predict Pulp Chamber Volume in Captive Baboons
entries.summary: 宾夕法尼亚大学、麦吉尔大学、西班牙 CENIEH 和芝加哥洛约拉大学团队研究了西南国家灵长类研究中心 46 只成年狒狒的 M1–M3 磨牙，检验髓腔体积、牙齿磨耗和牙面形貌之间的关系。下颌骨在 Bruker SkyScan 1273 上做 micro-CT 扫描（体素约 35–39 μm），髓腔体积在 Dragonfly（Object Research Systems）中测量：在正交切片视图里用灰度阈值加人工修正，把髓腔从周围牙本质中分割出来。结果显示校正后的髓腔体积随“磨耗年龄”、牙本质暴露比例和 Krueger-Scott 评分增加而减小，牙面形貌指标中只有起伏指数（RFI）在各颗磨牙上都与髓腔体积相关。
entries.summary_en: Teams at the University of Pennsylvania, McGill University, CENIEH (Spain) and Loyola University Chicago studied M1–M3 molars from 46 adult baboons of the Southwest National Primate Research Center to test how pulp chamber volume covaries with dental wear and dental topography. Mandibles were scanned on a Bruker SkyScan 1273 micro-CT (voxel size about 35–39 μm), and pulp chamber volume was measured in Dragonfly (Object Research Systems), segmenting the pulp from surrounding dentin by grayscale thresholding with manual refinement in orthogonal slice views. Corrected pulp volume decreased with wear age, dentin exposure ratio and Krueger-Scott scores, and relief index (RFI) was the only topography measure associated with pulp volume across molars.

entries.title: 捷克 Mladeč 中更新世棋斑游蛇脑颅形态：一项 CT 研究
entries.title_en: Braincase morphology of the Middle Pleistocene dice snake (Natrix tessellata) from Mladeč: a computed tomography study
entries.summary: 马萨里克大学的 Dohnal 和 Ivanov 研究了捷克 Mladeč 洞穴中更新世（Saalian 复合期，可能为 MIS 9e）出土的一件保存异常完整的棋斑游蛇（Natrix tessellata）化石脑颅。标本用 Phoenix v|tome|x S240 做 micro-CT 扫描，在 Dragonfly 3D World 2025.1 中处理，再用 MeshLab 生成各颅骨元素的三维模型并与现生欧洲支系和希腊支系对比。顶骨和副蝶骨的形态显示该化石属于如今只分布在希腊西部的希腊支系，说明这一支系在中更新世的分布范围比现在广得多。
entries.summary_en: Dohnal and Ivanov (Masaryk University) describe an unusually well-preserved, almost complete braincase of a fossil dice snake (Natrix tessellata) from the Middle Pleistocene (Saalian Complex, probably MIS 9e) of the Mladeč Caves, Czech Republic. The braincase was scanned with a Phoenix v|tome|x S240 micro-CT and processed in Dragonfly 3D World 2025.1, then 3D models of the cranial elements were built in MeshLab and compared with extant individuals of the Europe and Greece clades. The morphology of the parietal and parabasisphenoid assigns the fossil to the Greece clade, now restricted to western Greece, indicating a much wider Middle Pleistocene range for this lineage.
entries.source: 第 25 届捷克–斯洛伐克–波兰古生物学会议（会议摘要，马萨里克大学）

entries.title: 多功能复合磁性颗粒联合静磁场通过 SLC2A1 介导的 HIF-1 和 PI3K/AKT 通路治疗感染性骨缺损
entries.title_en: Multifunctional composite magnetic particles combined with static magnetic field for treating infectious bone defects via SLC2A1-mediated HIF-1 and PI3K/AKT pathways
entries.summary: 研究开发了多功能复合磁性颗粒 F-Fe₃O₄，并与静磁场联合用于感染性骨缺损。体外实验中它对人骨髓间充质干细胞生物相容性好，促进增殖、迁移和成骨分化，并抑制大肠杆菌、金黄色葡萄球菌和粪肠球菌，加静磁场后效果进一步增强；在大鼠感染性股骨缺损模型（经北京大学生物医学伦理委员会批准）中，联合治疗减轻早期感染和炎症、加快新骨形成，机制上与 SLC2A1 介导的葡萄糖摄取及 HIF-1、PI3K/AKT 通路激活有关。术后 4 周和 8 周的骨样本用 NanoVoxel-1000 显微 CT 扫描，Dragonfly 软件（Comet Technologies, Canada）用于图像重建和分析，计算 BV/TV、Tb.N 等骨形态参数。
entries.summary_en: The authors developed multifunctional composite magnetic particles (F-Fe₃O₄) and combined them with a static magnetic field to treat infectious bone defects. In vitro the particles were biocompatible with human bone marrow mesenchymal stem cells, promoted proliferation, migration and osteogenic differentiation, and inhibited E. coli, S. aureus and E. faecalis, with stronger effects under the field; in a rat infected femoral defect model (approved by Peking University's biomedical ethics committee) the combination reduced early infection and inflammation and accelerated new bone formation, linked to SLC2A1-mediated glucose uptake and HIF-1 and PI3K/AKT activation. Bone samples at 4 and 8 weeks were scanned on a NanoVoxel-1000 micro-CT, and Dragonfly software (Comet Technologies, Canada) was used for reconstruction and analysis of BV/TV, Tb.N and other trabecular parameters.

entries.title: 孵化温度与性别对温度诱导性反转鬃狮蜥胚胎脑发育的影响
entries.title_en: Impact of heat and sex on embryonic brain growth in dragons with temperature induced sex-reversal (Pogona vitticeps, Lacertilia: Agamidae)
entries.summary: 研究团队用缓冲卢戈氏碘液做对比增强显微 CT（µCT）和同步辐射传播相衬 CT，扫描了 57 枚中部鬃狮蜥（Pogona vitticeps）胚胎，分别在 28 ℃ 和 36 ℃ 下孵化，比较 ZW 雌性、ZZ 雄性和高温诱导的 ZZ 性反转雌性的脑发育。重建图像导入 Dragonfly 3D World（Comet Technologies Canada）判读发育分期，并用 Dragonfly 的 Segmentation 菜单把全脑和端脑从其他组织中分割出来；网格在 MeshLab 清理平滑后再导回 Dragonfly 自动读取各对象体积。结果显示 ZZ 基因型个体的端脑显著大于 ZW 雌性，而孵化温度虽影响生长速度和体型，对整体脑大小没有显著影响。所有 CT 数据连同 Dragonfly 格式的扫描与分割文件已在 FigShare 公开。
entries.summary_en: Researchers used buffered Lugol's iodine contrast-enhanced micro-CT and synchrotron propagation-based phase-contrast CT to scan 57 central bearded dragon (Pogona vitticeps) embryos incubated at 28 °C or 36 °C, comparing ZW females, ZZ males and heat-induced ZZ sex-reversed females. Reconstructions were imported into Dragonfly 3D World (Comet Technologies Canada) for developmental staging, and the whole brain and telencephalon were segmented with Dragonfly's Segmentation menu; meshes cleaned in MeshLab were re-imported into Dragonfly to read object volumes. The telencephalon was significantly larger in ZZ individuals than in ZW females, while incubation temperature affected growth rate and body size but not overall brain size. All CT data, including Dragonfly-format files with the segmentations, are openly available on FigShare.

entries.title: 整合结构分析揭示痘病毒核心中的多聚孔复合体
entries.title_en: A multimeric pore complex in the poxvirus core revealed by integrative structural analysis
entries.summary: 马普生物物理研究所、保罗·埃利希研究所、柏林 FMP 和夏里特医学院等团队结合冷冻电子断层、深度学习颗粒挑选、子断层平均、交联质谱和 AlphaFold3 建模，解析了痘病毒核心上长期寻找的孔道：它由病毒蛋白 E8、E6 和 L3 组成中空六聚管，贯穿核心壁和表面栅栏层，通道内的棒状密度与病毒 RNA 解旋酶 I8 一致，可能参与新合成 mRNA 的释放。论文中训练 3D U-Net 分割栅栏层时，预测结果在 cryoCAT 处理后在 Dragonfly 中人工修正作为第二轮训练的真值，最终所有预测掩膜也都在 Dragonfly 中逐一检查和修正（引用 ORS 2018 年 Dragonfly 深度学习平台论文）。
entries.summary_en: Teams at the Max Planck Institute of Biophysics, the Paul Ehrlich Institute, FMP Berlin and Charité combined cryo-electron tomography, deep-learning particle picking, subtomogram averaging, cross-linking mass spectrometry and AlphaFold3 modeling to resolve a long-sought pore in the poxvirus core: a hollow hexameric tube of viral proteins E8, E6 and L3 spanning the core wall and palisade layer, with a rod-like density consistent with the RNA helicase I8 that may help release new mRNAs. To train the 3D U-Net that segments the palisade, predictions were refined with cryoCAT and manually corrected in Dragonfly as ground truth for a second round, and all final predicted masks were inspected and refined in Dragonfly (citing ORS's 2018 Dragonfly deep-learning platform paper).

entries.title: 基质生物物理信号驱动乳腺癌细胞进入短暂或长期休眠
entries.title_en: Matrix biophysical cues drive transient or prolonged breast cancer dormancy programmes
entries.summary: 西班牙 Biogipuzkoa 健康研究所和巴斯克大学等团队构建了刚度匹配的 GelMA 和海藻酸盐三维水凝胶，把基质刚度与黏附性、可降解性分开，研究它们对乳腺癌细胞休眠的影响。共聚焦 z-stack 图像在 Dragonfly 2025.1（Comet Technologies Canada）中做三维重建和分析，用 Segmentation Wizard 以人工标注的 2D 帧训练 U-Net 模型，区分肿瘤团块与单细胞并量化体积和球形度。结果显示黏附、可降解的基质支持增殖性肿瘤团块，惰性基质则促使单细胞休眠：软基质对应 SOX9 相关的短暂类干细胞休眠，硬基质对应 NR2F1 相关的长期休眠；从软基质取出的细胞在鸡胚绒毛尿囊膜中仍不成瘤，患者来源细胞也表现出类似休眠和耐药。
entries.summary_en: Teams at the Biogipuzkoa Health Research Institute and the University of the Basque Country engineered stiffness-matched GelMA and alginate 3D hydrogels to separate matrix stiffness from adhesion and degradability in breast cancer dormancy. Confocal z-stacks were reconstructed and analyzed in Dragonfly 2025.1 (Comet Technologies Canada), with a U-Net trained in the Segmentation Wizard on manually labelled 2D frames to separate tumour masses from single cells and quantify volume and sphericity. Adhesive, degradable matrices supported proliferative tumour masses, while inert matrices favoured single-cell dormancy: soft matrices induced SOX9-associated transient stem-like dormancy and stiff ones NR2F1-associated prolonged dormancy. Cells retrieved from soft matrices still failed to form tumours on chicken chorioallantoic membranes, and patient-derived cells showed similar dormancy and therapy resistance.

entries.title: 干湿循环对荷兰膨胀黏土水力-力学行为的影响
entries.title_en: Effect of Cyclic Drying-Wetting on the Hydromechanical Behaviour of a Dutch Expansive Clay
entries.summary: 研究对象是荷兰 Zevenaar 的膨胀黏土，在受控条件下施加干湿循环，测量膨胀压力、体积变化和孔隙结构演变。结果显示一维膨胀压力约为吸力的 24%，与干湿历史、试验类型和施加应力无关；收缩和膨胀基本可逆，没有累积永久变形。样品在 CoreTOM 显微 CT 上于天然状态和各干湿阶段末扫描，孔隙分析在 Dragonfly 3D World（Comet Technologies Canada）中完成，通过图像阈值把孔隙与固体基质分开，统计孔隙率和孔隙体积分布；μCT 显示随循环次数增加微孔数量和中孔体积上升，提示孔隙逐步重排、更易开裂。
entries.summary_en: The study applied controlled drying-wetting cycles to an expansive clay from Zevenaar, the Netherlands, measuring swelling pressure, volume change and pore-structure evolution. One-dimensional swelling pressure was about 24% of suction regardless of cycle history, test type or applied stress, and shrinkage and swelling were largely reversible with no accumulated permanent deformation. The sample was scanned on a CoreTOM micro-CT in its natural state and after each phase, and pore analysis was done in Dragonfly 3D World (Comet Technologies Canada) by thresholding pores from the solid matrix to quantify porosity and pore-volume distribution; micropore number and mesopore volume grew with each cycle, pointing to progressive pore rearrangement and higher susceptibility to cracking.
entries.source: 第 15 届 IAEG 世界大会论文集（IAEG 2026）
entries.source_en: Proceedings of the 15th IAEG World Congress (IAEG 2026)

entries.title: 高蛋白牛肉零食配方与工艺参数的多响应优化：提升机械脆度、声学脆度和蛋白消化率
entries.title_en: Multi-Response Optimization of Formulation and Processing Parameters for a High-Protein Beef-Based Snack to Enhance Mechanical Crispiness, Acoustic Crispiness, and Protein Digestibility
entries.summary: 澳大利亚科廷大学团队用响应面法优化牛肉脆片的牛肉粉添加量、挤出片厚度和烘烤时间，得到牛肉粉 65.8%–67.7%、烘烤 14.0–14.8 分钟、片厚 1.0 mm 的最优配方，优化后脆度可接受度 67.5 ± 1.3，高于未优化配方的 60.8 ± 3.3。作为优化后的验证，样品在 Zeiss Versa XRM-500 上以 4 µm 像素扫描，2D 截面和 3D 重建图像用 Dragonfly 3D World 2024.1（Comet Technologies Canada）生成，并用 Otsu 法自动做孔隙分割。显微 CT 显示最优牛肉脆片的孔更小、连通性更好，孔隙连通性更接近商品薯片。
entries.summary_en: A Curtin University team used response surface methodology to optimize beef powder level, extruded sheet thickness and baking time for beef chips, arriving at 65.8%–67.7% beef powder, 14.0–14.8 min baking and 1.0 mm sheets; crispiness acceptability of the optimized chip was 67.5 ± 1.3 versus 60.8 ± 3.3 for a non-optimized chip. For post-optimization checks, samples were scanned on a Zeiss Versa XRM-500 at 4 µm pixels, 2D sections and 3D reconstructions were produced in Dragonfly 3D World 2024.1 (Comet Technologies Canada), and pores were segmented automatically with Otsu thresholding. The optimized chip showed smaller, better-connected pores, with connectivity closer to a commercial potato chip.

entries.title: 预凝固硫酸钙二水合物/羟基磷灰石骨移植增量材料在兔腰椎后外侧融合模型中的评估
entries.title_en: Evaluation of a Pre-set Calcium Sulphate Dihydrate/Hydroxyapatite Bone Graft Extender in a Rabbit Posterolateral Spinal Fusion Model
entries.summary: 瑞典隆德大学与立陶宛健康科学大学在 26 只兔的 L4–L5 后外侧腰椎融合模型中，评估 XERAFUSE 预凝固硫酸钙二水合物/羟基磷灰石颗粒按 1:1 与自体骨合用作为骨移植增量材料的效果。离体 micro-CT（30 µm 体素）在 Dragonfly 3D World 1.14.4.1 中做定量形态学和三维可视化：先用 1900–6500 HU 全局阈值分出矿化组织，再用 Dragonfly 的 Segmentation Wizard（训练分类器）把融合区分为骨组织和残余材料，两名评估者独立标注，结果差异小于 15%，并用「Bone」预设生成三维重建。12 周时增量材料组骨体积 850 ± 68.4 mm³，显著高于单用自体骨组的 468.9 ± 105.3 mm³；融合块中材料占比从 4 周的 41.3% 降到 12 周的 28.1%。作者致谢 Comet Technologies（加拿大）提供 Dragonfly 非商业许可。
entries.summary_en: Lund University (Sweden) and the Lithuanian University of Health Sciences evaluated XERAFUSE pre-set calcium sulphate dihydrate/hydroxyapatite granules, co-implanted 1:1 with autograft as a bone graft extender, in an L4–L5 posterolateral lumbar fusion model in 26 rabbits. Ex vivo micro-CT (30 µm voxels) was analyzed and visualized in Dragonfly 3D World 1.14.4.1: a 1900–6500 HU global threshold isolated mineralized tissue, then Dragonfly's Segmentation Wizard (a trained classifier) separated the fusion mass into bone and residual biomaterial, with two independent evaluators agreeing within 15%, and 3D reconstructions were made with the "Bone" preset. At 12 weeks bone volume in the extender group was 850 ± 68.4 mm³ versus 468.9 ± 105.3 mm³ with autograft alone, and the material fraction of the fusion mass fell from 41.3% at 4 weeks to 28.1% at 12 weeks. The authors thank Comet Technologies (Canada) for a non-commercial Dragonfly license.
entries.source_en: North American Spine Society Journal (NASSJ, Elsevier)

entries.title: Dragonfly 3D World 2027：学术许可与完整许可的区别
entries.title_en: Dragonfly 3D World 2027: Understanding Academic and Full Licenses
entries.summary: 官方博客说明 3D World 2027 的两种许可：学术许可（原 FreeD）继续免费提供给符合条件的非商业科研和教学用户，期限一年、可每年免费续期，2027 版新增 Grid-Based SAM 与 Cellpose-SAM 实例分割、Fast Split 和 Smart Erode 分离粘连对象、旋转视图以及卡尺、标量箭头等标注测量工具；完整许可为付费的年度或永久授权，独有 Subvoxel Multi-Mesh、表面粗糙度分析和高级报告生成器选项，这些功能在学术版中可见但呈灰色不可用。学术许可在软件内 Help > Request Academic License 申请，现有学术用户可免费升级到 2027 版，免费学术许可受地区分销协议限制。
entries.summary_en: The official blog explains the two 3D World 2027 licenses. The Academic License (formerly FreeD) stays free for eligible non-commercial research and teaching, runs one year and renews annually at no charge, and in 2027 adds Grid-Based SAM and Cellpose-SAM instance segmentation, Fast Split and Smart Erode for separating touching objects, Rotational Views, and Caliper and Scalar Arrow annotations. The paid Full License (annual or perpetual) adds Subvoxel Multi-Mesh, Surface Roughness Analysis and advanced Report Builder options, which appear grayed out in the Academic version. Academic licenses are requested in the software via Help > Request Academic License, existing academic users can upgrade to 2027 at no cost, and free academic licenses are subject to regional restrictions.

entries.title: 用 X 射线相衬断层成像研究猪模型中的纹身颗粒
entries.title_en: Investigating tattoo particles in the porcine model using X-ray phase-contrast tomography
entries.summary: 研究团队结合同步辐射单光栅相衬显微 CT、Zernike 相衬纳米 CT 和 TEM，研究 28 天猪模型纹身皮肤和一例对红色颜料过敏的人体活检，追踪颜料团聚体在皮肤各层中的三维分布和第 7、14、28 天的免疫反应；体积定量只回收了预期 TiO₂ 含量的 6.4%，显示显微 CT 的局限。表皮、真皮、皮下层的分割使用 Dragonfly 3D World 2025（Comet Technologies Canada）。
entries.summary_en: The team combined synchrotron single-grid phase-contrast micro-CT, Zernike phase-contrast nano-CT and TEM to study tattooed skin in a 28-day porcine model and a human biopsy with an allergic reaction to a red pigment, tracking the 3D distribution of pigment agglomerates across skin layers and the immune response at days 7, 14 and 28; volume quantification recovered only 6.4% of the expected TiO₂, showing a limit of micro-CT. Epidermis, dermis and hypodermis were segmented in Dragonfly 3D World 2025 (Comet Technologies Canada).

entries.title: 骨-种植体界面的骨整合动态：接触成骨与远距成骨
entries.title_en: Osseointegration dynamics at bone-implant interface: contact and distant osteogenesis
entries.summary: 巴黎萨克雷大学 CentraleSupélec 与 CNRS 团队把带骨腔的 TiAl6V4 种植体植入兔胫骨 7 周和 13 周，用 SEM 背散射图像观察新生骨：腔内骨分数在两周期间增加 42%，同时见到接触成骨和远距成骨，新生骨中的骨管和骨细胞陷窝都比成熟骨大。图像在 Dragonfly（Comet Technologies Canada）中用 Otsu 自动阈值把骨与骨管、骨细胞陷窝分开并做定量。
entries.summary_en: CentraleSupélec (Université Paris-Saclay) and CNRS implanted TiAl6V4 implants with a bone chamber in rabbit tibiae for 7 and 13 weeks and examined new bone with SEM backscattered imaging: bone fraction in the chamber rose 42% between the two time points, both contact and distant osteogenesis were seen, and canals and osteocyte lacunae were larger in new bone than in mature bone. Bone was segmented from canals and osteocyte lacunae with automatic Otsu thresholding in Dragonfly (Comet Technologies Canada).
entries.source: Multidisciplinary Biomechanics Journal（法国生物力学学会 2026 年会）
entries.source_en: Multidisciplinary Biomechanics Journal (Société de Biomécanique 2026 congress)

entries.title: 气液界面矿化过程中的非经典 Mullins-Sekerka 失稳
entries.title_en: Non-classical Mullins-Sekerka instability during mineralization at gas-liquid interfaces
entries.summary: 于利希研究中心（FZ Jülich）等团队用三维 FIB-SEM 断层成像、定量表面分析和反应输运模拟，研究 CO₂ 气泡生长界面上的重晶石矿化，发现界面虽多孔、多晶且受孔隙空间约束，扩散驱动的失稳依然存在，但模式选择发生改变，属于非经典 Mullins-Sekerka 情形。FIB-SEM 断层数据用 Dragonfly 3D World 重建，孔体积也由 Dragonfly 测定后用于孔径分布分析。
entries.summary_en: A team led by Forschungszentrum Jülich combined 3D FIB-SEM tomography, quantitative surface analysis and reactive transport modelling to study barite mineralization on growing CO₂ bubble interfaces, showing that diffusion-driven instability persists on a porous, polycrystalline, pore-confined interface but with modified mode selection, a non-classical Mullins-Sekerka regime. The FIB-SEM tomogram was reconstructed in Dragonfly 3D World, and pore volumes determined in Dragonfly were used for pore size distribution analysis.

entries.title: 从重建到解读：可零设置部署的 X 射线断层多相分割模型
entries.title_en: From reconstruction to interpretation: zero-setup deployable model for multi-phase segmentation of X-ray tomography data
entries.summary: 劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室先进光源（ALS）与辛辛那提大学提出一种同步辐射 X 射线断层多相分割框架，用可复用的衰减和形态掩膜类别加预训练语义分割网络，不需要提示、调参或重新训练就能对新数据给出初步分割，用四块 A100 GPU 分割 500 层 2560×2560 体数据用时 67.1 秒。据同一团队的预印本（arXiv:2607.12175）方法部分，训练用的真值掩膜由商业软件 Dragonfly（ORS）通过阈值和最大连通域等操作制作。
entries.summary_en: The Advanced Light Source at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory and the University of Cincinnati present a framework for multi-phase segmentation of synchrotron X-ray tomography that combines reusable attenuation- and morphology-based mask categories with a pretrained semantic segmentation network, giving first-pass segmentations of new data without prompting, tuning or retraining; a 500-slice 2560×2560 volume took 67.1 s on four A100 GPUs. According to the methods of the team's preprint (arXiv:2607.12175), ground-truth masks for training were prepared in the commercial software Dragonfly (ORS) using thresholding and largest-connected-component operations.

entries.title: 可规模化自组装超材料中的手性反转与巨光学活性
entries.title_en: Chirality Inversion and Giant Optical Activity in Scalable Self-Assembled Metamaterials
entries.summary: 研究团队把金属纳米颗粒和生物来源的甲壳素纳米晶共组装成分级螺旋超材料，获得强等离激元光学活性（不对称因子达 0.55），并可通过调节螺距在不改变模板手性的情况下反转光学手性，金纳米颗粒还能从干膜中回收再分散。FIB-SEM 断层图像的堆栈对齐与分割，以及每个金双锥颗粒的位置和取向提取，均在 Dragonfly（ORS）中完成。
entries.summary_en: The team co-assembled metallic nanoparticles with bio-sourced chitin nanocrystals into hierarchical helicoidal metamaterials with strong plasmonic optical activity (dissymmetry factor up to 0.55), and by tuning the helical pitch inverted the optical handedness without changing the template's handedness; the gold nanoparticles can also be recovered from dry films and redispersed. FIB-SEM tomography stack alignment and segmentation, and extraction of each gold bipyramid's position and orientation, were done in Dragonfly (ORS).

entries.title: 原位电化学液池 TEM 揭示锯齿形 Pt₃Fe 纳米线的结构演变与元素重分布
entries.title_en: Coupled structural evolution and elemental redistribution in zigzag Pt3Fe nanowires revealed by in situ electrochemical liquid-cell TEM
entries.summary: 布鲁克海文国家实验室与劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室等团队用原位电化学液池 TEM、原位 X 射线吸收谱、电子断层和静电模拟，追踪弱碱性析氢反应中锯齿形 Pt₃Fe 纳米线的演变：高曲率处出现凸起和富 Pt 纳米颗粒，Fe 被选择性脱除。电子断层显示纳米线是厚约 6 nm 的薄片状而非此前认为的螺旋状；断层数据的可视化和分割使用 Dragonfly 2025.1（ORS）。
entries.summary_en: Teams from Brookhaven and Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratories used in situ electrochemical liquid-cell TEM, in situ X-ray absorption spectroscopy, electron tomography and electrostatic simulations to track zigzag Pt₃Fe nanowires during the hydrogen evolution reaction in weakly alkaline conditions, observing protrusions and Pt-rich nanoparticles forming at high-curvature sites along with selective Fe removal. Electron tomography showed the nanowires are thin plates about 6 nm thick rather than spirals; the tomography data were visualized and segmented in Dragonfly 2025.1 (ORS).

entries.title: 深分支捕食性原生生物的适应性运动与摄食策略
entries.title_en: Adaptive motility and feeding strategies of deep-branching predatory protists
entries.summary: 埃克塞特大学 Living Systems Institute 与巴黎萨克雷大学等团队用高分辨单细胞追踪和空间统计，比较海洋 Jakoba libera 与淡水 Reclinomonas americana 等古虫类鞭毛虫的运动和摄食：前者主动觅食，后者是严格的滤食者，猎物多少对两者游动的影响方向相反。全息断层和膨胀显微（U-ExM）图像的三维重建在 Dragonfly 3D World（Comet Technologies Canada）中完成。
entries.summary_en: The University of Exeter's Living Systems Institute, Université Paris-Saclay and colleagues used high-resolution single-cell tracking and spatial statistics to compare excavate flagellates such as marine Jakoba libera and freshwater Reclinomonas americana, finding the former is an active forager and the latter a strict filter feeder, with prey availability affecting their swimming in opposite ways. 3D reconstructions of holo-tomography and expansion microscopy (U-ExM) images were made in Dragonfly 3D World (Comet Technologies Canada).

entries.title: 常压下生长 ScB₂ 晶体，用作 AlGaN 功率电子衬底
entries.title_en: Enabling the Ambient Pressure Growth of ScB2 Crystals for AlGaN Power Electronics
entries.summary: 研究团队在激光加热光学浮区炉中用移动溶剂法在常压下生长出超高温陶瓷 ScB₂ 单晶，富 B 自助熔剂生长的晶锭在初始成核区后为单畴、无晶界，表明 ScB₂ 可作为富 Al 的 AlGaN 功率微电子的晶格匹配衬底候选。晶锭用 Bruker SkyScan 1172 显微 CT 扫描，数据用 Dragonfly 2021.1（ORS）分析。
entries.summary_en: The team grew single-crystal ScB₂, an ultrahigh-temperature ceramic, at ambient pressure in a laser-heated optical floating zone furnace using the travelling solvent method; boules grown from B-rich self-flux were single-domain and free of grain boundaries after the initial nucleation region, making ScB₂ a lattice-matched substrate candidate for Al-rich AlGaN power electronics. A boule was scanned on a Bruker SkyScan 1172 micro-CT, and the data were analyzed in Dragonfly 2021.1 (ORS).

entries.title: 鲎的伤口愈合与再生：对三叶虫损伤化石的可能启示
entries.title_en: Healing and regeneration in horseshoe crab, with possible application to trilobite injuries
entries.summary: 西北大学（西安）大陆演化与早期生命国家重点实验室等团队以鲎作为三叶虫的现生替身做截肢实验，观察蜕皮后伤口的愈合与再生，用来解读三叶虫化石上的损伤痕迹。伤口组织经 5% 磷钨酸（PTA）染色后在蔡司 Xradia 520 上做显微 CT 扫描，CT 数据在 Dragonfly 4.0 中做三维体渲染。
entries.summary_en: A team led by Northwest University's State Key Laboratory of Continental Evolution and Early Life (Xi'an) amputated appendages of juvenile horseshoe crabs as a living proxy for trilobites and followed wound healing and regeneration after molting, to help interpret injuries seen on trilobite fossils. Wound tissue stained with 5% phosphotungstic acid (PTA) was scanned by micro-CT on a ZEISS Xradia 520, and the CT data were processed in Dragonfly 4.0 for 3D volume rendering.

entries.title: 用废弃煤燃烧灰与废玻璃混合烧结制备轻骨料：煤灰化学与矿物组成的影响
entries.title_en: Production of lightweight aggregate (LWA) by sintering blend of waste coal combustion ash (WCCA) and waste glass (WG): understanding the effect of WCCA chemical and mineralogical composition
entries.summary: 德雷塞尔大学用六种废弃煤灰与 0–50% 废玻璃在 1100 °C 烧结轻骨料，发现煤灰的 Fe₂O₃、烧失量、非晶相含量高且莫来石少时，25% 废玻璃即可成型，否则需约 50%。骨料在蔡司 Xradia 620 Versa 上以 12 µm 体素扫描，用 Dragonfly 软件建立三维模型并分析孔隙，结合 K-means 聚类与 Otsu 分割区分固相和孔隙，并与商用膨胀玻璃、膨胀黏土骨料对比孔结构。
entries.summary_en: Drexel University sintered lightweight aggregates at 1100 °C from six waste coal combustion ashes blended with 0–50% waste glass, finding that ashes with higher Fe₂O₃, loss on ignition and amorphous content and less mullite formed sound aggregates with only 25% glass, while others needed about 50%. The aggregates were scanned on a ZEISS Xradia 620 Versa at 12 µm voxel size, and Dragonfly software was used to build 3D models and analyze porosity, with K-means clustering plus Otsu segmentation separating solid and pore phases for comparison with commercial expanded glass and expanded clay aggregates.

entries.title: 石蜡/剑麻复合相变纤维对 3D 打印混凝土流变与传热行为的影响
entries.title_en: Effects of Paraffin/Sisal Composite Phase Change Fibers on the Rheological and Heat-Transfer Behaviors of 3D-Printed Concrete
entries.summary: 东南大学把自制的石蜡/剑麻复合相变纤维掺入 3D 打印混凝土，研究其流变和传热：相变纤维组导热更低、表面升温更慢，且 X、Y、Z 方向传热不同。试件用 YXLON 工业 CT 扫描，三维重建后在 Dragonfly（2024.1 版）中用深度学习分割区分纤维、浆体和孔隙（灰度阈值法难以分开纤维与孔隙），再把体积切成 512 个 5 mm 立方单元统计纤维体积分数和取向，显示相变纤维分散更均匀、打印件中纤维沿打印方向排列。
entries.summary_en: Southeast University added self-made paraffin/sisal composite phase change fibers to 3D-printed concrete and studied rheology and heat transfer: the phase-change-fiber mix showed lower thermal conductivity, slower surface temperature rise and direction-dependent heat transfer along X, Y and Z. Specimens were scanned with a YXLON industrial CT, and after 3D reconstruction Dragonfly (version 2024.1) deep-learning segmentation separated fibers, paste and pores, which grayscale thresholding could not distinguish; the volume was then split into 512 cubes of 5 mm to measure fiber volume fraction and orientation, showing more uniform dispersion of phase change fibers and fiber alignment along the printing direction in printed specimens.

entries.title: 基于神经网络与 MC X-ray 蒙特卡罗模拟的 20 kV 均质多元素块体样品定量分析方法
entries.title_en: A neural network-based Monte Carlo X-ray (MC X-ray) approach for quantitative analysis of homogeneous multi-element bulk samples at 20 kV
entries.summary: 麦吉尔大学采矿与材料工程系与 Dragonfly（Comet Group，蒙特利尔）合作，用蒙特卡罗程序 MC X-ray 在 20 kV 条件下模拟约 3000 组 EDS 谱图及对应元素质量分数，训练多层感知机（MLP）直接从整条谱图预测成分，实现无需物理标样的 SEM-EDS 定量分析。在 11 种经认证的标准矿物上验证，RMSE 为 0.0056–0.0179，R² 为 0.9873–0.9981，质量分数不低于 0.05 的元素平均绝对百分比误差 4.41%，在消费级笔记本上约 15 分钟完成；质量分数低于 0.05 的微量元素仍不可靠。论文指出 MC X-ray 已集成进图像分析平台 Dragonfly，并可借 Dragonfly 的 Python 扩展用一个脚本批量生成训练数据，后续将利用 Dragonfly MC X-ray 模块的几何配置扩展到薄膜、多层等复杂样品。
entries.summary_en: McGill University's Department of Mining and Materials Engineering and Dragonfly (Comet Group, Montréal) used the MC X-ray Monte Carlo program to simulate about 3,000 EDS spectra with matching elemental weight fractions at 20 kV and trained a multilayer perceptron to predict composition from the full spectrum, enabling standards-free SEM-EDS quantification. Validated on 11 certified mineral standards, it gave RMSE of 0.0056–0.0179 and R² of 0.9873–0.9981, with a 4.41% mean absolute percentage error for elements at weight fractions of at least 0.05, in about 15 minutes on a consumer laptop; trace elements below 0.05 remain unreliable. The paper notes that MC X-ray has been integrated into the Dragonfly image analysis platform, whose Python extension generates large training datasets from a single script, and plans to use the Dragonfly MC X-ray module's geometry options to extend the method to thin films and multilayer samples.

entries.title: 中世纪银丝饰件高分辨率中子断层成像中富汞鎏金比例的蒙特卡罗约束
entries.title_en: Monte Carlo bounds on Hg-rich amalgam gilding in high-resolution neutron tomography of medieval filigree
entries.summary: 澳大利亚核科学与技术组织（ANSTO）与米兰比可卡大学等团队把 13 世纪 Chiaravalle 十字架银丝饰件碎片的中子 CT 与 SEM–EDS 及 Geant4 模拟（Dingo 束线模型）结合：模拟的银丝与焊点有效衰减系数与中子 CT 测值一致，并在所选端元组合下给出富汞鎏金区域面积比例约 24.3% 的保守模型上限。重建体数据在 Dragonfly（ORS，v2022.2）中可视化，用 Otsu 阈值加形态学操作分割银丝、焊点和残余鎏金，在 30 个 ROI 上提取衰减值，并导出 STL 网格供 Geant4 使用。
entries.summary_en: ANSTO and University of Milano-Bicocca researchers combined neutron CT of a filigree fragment from the 13th-century Chiaravalle Cross with SEM–EDS and Geant4 simulations of the Dingo beamline. Simulated attenuation for the wire and solder joint matched the nCT values, and for the selected endmember pair the model gives a conservative upper bound of about 24.3% on the Hg-rich gilding area fraction. The reconstructed volume was visualised in Dragonfly (ORS, v2022.2), where wire, solder and residual gilding were segmented with Otsu thresholds and morphological operations, attenuation was sampled in 30 ROIs, and STL meshes were exported for Geant4.

entries.title: 基于德国东北部吕根岛上白垩统一件保存极佳标本重新评估异常海蛇尾属 Astrosombra
entries.title_en: Re-assessment of the aberrant brittle star genus Astrosombra (Echinodermata, Ophiuroidea), based on an exceptionally preserved specimen from the Upper Cretaceous of Rügen, north-east Germany
entries.summary: 卢森堡国家自然历史博物馆、柏林自然博物馆等团队描述了白垩纪海蛇尾 Astrosombra rammsteinensis 的首件关节完整标本，并据此支持把该属归入 Ophiopsilidae。标本盘部 micro-CT（各向同性体素 35.6 µm）在 Dragonfly 2022.1（Object Research Systems）中以体渲染方式可视化。
entries.summary_en: Researchers from the Luxembourg National Museum of Natural History, the Museum für Naturkunde Berlin and others describe the first articulated specimen of the Cretaceous brittle star Astrosombra rammsteinensis, supporting the genus's placement in Ophiopsilidae. Micro-CT of the disc (35.6 µm isotropic voxels) was visualised with volume renderings in Dragonfly 2022.1 (Object Research Systems).

entries.title: 红外化学活检：对完整骨骼进行无损成分评估
entries.title_en: Infrared Chemical Biopsy for Non-Destructive Compositional Assessment of Intact Bone
entries.summary: 史蒂文斯理工学院团队提出“红外化学活检”：用光纤近红外光谱直接在人髂骨外侧面采集谱图，再取空间配对的经髂骨环钻活检，做 micro-CT 和压缩试验，把完整部位的成分信息与三维结构和力学行为对应起来。活检的 micro-CT 重建数据在 Dragonfly 3D World（Object Research Systems）中分割并可视化皮质壳和下方的骨小梁结构。
entries.summary_en: A Stevens Institute of Technology team introduces Infrared Chemical Biopsy: fiber-optic near-infrared spectra are taken directly from the lateral surface of the human ilium, then a spatially matched transiliac trephine biopsy is characterised by micro-CT and compression testing, linking intact-site composition with 3D structure and mechanics. The biopsy's reconstructed micro-CT volume was processed in Dragonfly 3D World (Object Research Systems) to segment and visualise the cortical shell and the underlying trabecular architecture.

entries.title: 优化鬣蜥脑的神经对比度并减少组织收缩：缓冲 Lugol 碘与磷钨酸用于增强对比 µCT 的比较
entries.title_en: Optimising neural contrast and minimising tissue shrinkage in dragon lizard brains: buffered Lugol's iodine versus phosphotungstic acid for contrast-enhanced µCT
entries.summary: 拉筹伯大学与墨尔本大学团队在 1.25%、2.5%、5% 三种浓度下比较缓冲 Lugol 碘与水溶液磷钨酸（PTA）对 Jacky 鬣蜥（Amphibolurus muricatus）脑的 µCT 增强效果：缓冲 Lugol 碘最快 4 天即可完全染透，白质/灰质对比明显更好；PTA 约需 3 周，且脑-颅腔占比低 13.3%，脑组织收缩约多 20%。重建数据导入 Dragonfly 3D World 2025.1（Comet Technologies Canada），用于数据对齐、用 Point set 工具取点测灰度，以及手动分割脑、脑室和颅内模并计算体积。
entries.summary_en: La Trobe University and University of Melbourne researchers compared buffered Lugol's iodine with aqueous phosphotungstic acid (PTA) at 1.25%, 2.5% and 5% for µCT of Jacky dragon (Amphibolurus muricatus) brains. Buffered Lugol's stained the brain fully in as little as four days and gave clearly better white–grey matter contrast, while PTA needed about three weeks, showed 13.3% lower brain-to-endocast occupancy and roughly 20% more brain tissue shrinkage. Reconstructed volumes were imported into Dragonfly 3D World 2025.1 (Comet Technologies Canada) to align datasets, sample grey values with the Point set tool, and manually segment the brain, ventricles and endocast for volume measurements.

entries.title: 髋部结构分析中固定皮质骨比例假设会对股骨颈形态估计产生随性别和年龄变化的系统误差
entries.title_en: The fixed cortical fraction assumption in Hip Structure Analysis produces systematic, sex- and age- dependent errors in femoral neck morphology estimates
entries.summary: 密歇根大学骨科团队利用 62 例尸体股骨近端的 nanoCT 数据检验髋部结构分析（HSA）中固定 60% 皮质骨比例的假设，发现它会给股骨颈形态估计带来随性别和年龄变化的系统误差。各体数据在 Dragonfly（Comet Technologies）中旋转 15° 以校正前倾角，并用自编 Dragonfly 插件把骨体素投影生成 pseudoDXA 图像。
entries.summary_en: A University of Michigan orthopaedic surgery team used nanoCT volumes of 62 cadaveric proximal femurs to test the fixed 60% cortical-fraction assumption in Hip Structure Analysis (HSA), showing that it produces systematic sex- and age-dependent errors in femoral neck morphology estimates. Each volume was rotated 15° in Dragonfly (Comet Technologies) to account for anteversion, and pseudoDXA images were generated by projecting bone voxels with a custom Dragonfly plug-in.

entries.title: 扩展的 Lpt 通路把拟杆菌表面脂蛋白输出与外膜囊泡生成耦合起来
entries.title_en: An Expanded Lpt Pathway Couples Surface Lipoprotein Export to Outer Membrane Vesicle Biogenesis in Bacteroides
entries.summary: 华盛顿大学医学院牵头的团队鉴定出此前未被表征的蛋白 LptZ，它是拟杆菌表面暴露脂蛋白转运与外膜囊泡（OMV）生成之间的关键环节；lptZ 突变体的冷冻电子断层图像显示成串囊泡仍拴在外膜上，呈现 OMV 形成被阻滞的中间阶段。断层数据导入 Dragonfly 后，用 Segmentation Wizard 训练深度学习模型完成分割，再人工修正并用 Smooth Mesh 平滑表面。
entries.summary_en: A Washington University School of Medicine-led team identified LptZ, a previously uncharacterized protein, as a key link between surface-exposed lipoprotein export and outer membrane vesicle (OMV) biogenesis in Bacteroides; cryo-electron tomography of the lptZ mutant showed chains of vesicles still tethered to the outer membrane, an arrested stage of OMV formation. Tomograms were imported into Dragonfly and segmented with a deep-learning model trained in the Segmentation Wizard, then corrected manually and polished with the Smooth Mesh tool.

entries.title: 首个转基因头足类动物的建立
entries.title_en: Generation of a transgenic cephalopod
entries.summary: 哥伦比亚大学 Zuckerman 研究所与霍华德·休斯医学研究所（Axel 实验室）报告了稳定转基因的侏儒乌贼（Ascarosepion bandense），可普遍表达核定位红色荧光蛋白 mScarlet；CRISPR 敲入以及 Sleeping Beauty、Minos 转座子都成功建系，其中 Minos 效率最高。转基因成体脑经 EZ Clear 透明化后做光片显微成像，数据用 Dragonfly 3D World 可视化。
entries.summary_en: Columbia University's Zuckerman Institute and HHMI (Axel lab) report stable transgenic dwarf cuttlefish (Ascarosepion bandense) that ubiquitously express nuclear-localized mScarlet; lines were established with CRISPR knock-in and with the Sleeping Beauty and Minos transposons, Minos being the most efficient. Brains of transgenic adults were cleared with EZ Clear and imaged by light-sheet microscopy, and the data were visualised in Dragonfly 3D World.

entries.title: 让三维图像显露结构：Dragonfly 3D World ZEISS 版的机器学习分割
entries.title_en: Teaching a 3D Image to Reveal Its Structure
entries.summary: CMM Quarterly 刊文（作者 Mark Boucher）介绍 Dragonfly 3D World ZEISS 版的机器学习分割：分析者先标注代表性区域，用 Segmentation Wizard 训练经典机器学习或深度学习模型，再推广到整个数据集。文章以多孔制造零件的 X 射线显微扫描为例，给出准备数据、标注样例、训练预览、纠错再训练、测量孔隙率与连通性的流程，并强调结果必须经专家核验。
entries.summary_en: A CMM Quarterly article by Mark Boucher explains machine-learning segmentation in Dragonfly 3D World ZEISS edition: the analyst labels representative regions, trains a classical machine-learning or deep-learning model in the Segmentation Wizard, and applies it to the full dataset. Using an X-ray microscopy scan of a porous manufactured part as the example, it walks through preparing the scan, labeling examples, training and previewing, correcting and retraining, and measuring porosity and connectivity, stressing that results still need expert validation.

entries.title: 鱼和小鼠视锥外节周围的 Müller 胶质—视网膜色素上皮顶端网络
entries.title_en: A Müller Glia-Retinal Pigment Epithelium Apical Network Surrounding Cone Outer Segments in Fish and Mouse
entries.summary: 阿尔伯塔大学与蒙特利尔临床研究所（IRCM）/麦吉尔大学团队用 FIB-SEM 和共聚焦显微成像重新审视视网膜下腔结构，发现 Müller 胶质和视网膜色素上皮（RPE）都伸出长的顶端突起，彼此接触并共同包绕视锥外节，形成此前未被认识的三方界面；这种结构在斑马鱼中很发达，在小鼠中较稀疏但同样存在。斑马鱼 FIB-SEM 数据（6×6×10 nm 体素、1750 层）在 Dragonfly 3D World 2024.1 中用内置 Stack Alignment 对齐，每隔 10–20 层手动分割，再用 Z 向自动插值并人工修正，完成三维重建。
entries.summary_en: Researchers at the University of Alberta and IRCM/McGill used FIB-SEM and confocal imaging to revisit the subretinal space, showing that Müller glia and the retinal pigment epithelium (RPE) extend long apical processes that contact each other and together ensheath cone outer segments, a previously unrecognized tripartite interface that is elaborate in zebrafish and sparser but present in mouse. The zebrafish FIB-SEM stack (6×6×10 nm voxels, 1,750 slices) was aligned with the built-in Stack Alignment in Dragonfly 3D World 2024.1, manually segmented every 10–20th section, then completed with automatic Z interpolation and manual correction.

entries.title: 真皮骨的承重功能适应：俄罗斯鲟胸鳍棘
entries.title_en: Functional Adaptations for Load-Bearing in a Dermal Bone: The Pectoral Fin Spine of the Russian Sturgeon (Huso gueldenstaedtii)
entries.summary: 希伯来大学兽医学院团队从结构（光镜、偏光、micro-CT、SEM）、成分（FTIR、TGA、骨矿密度）和力学（三点弯曲、微压痕）三方面表征俄罗斯鲟胸鳍棘，发现它由真皮骨单位骨和平行纤维骨构成，结构高度有序、韧性高，可同时承担运动和防护功能，内部还有相互连通的神经血管管道网络。micro-CT 数据在 Dragonfly 2022.2 中用分割向导训练加手动修正分割管道网络并生成阈值网格测管径，用 Bone Wizard 测胸鳍棘和取样骨条的孔隙率，并分割骨细胞陷窝。（与 10 月 24 日收录的同一团队 FIB-SEM 论文是姊妹研究。）
entries.summary_en: A Hebrew University veterinary team characterized the Russian sturgeon pectoral fin spine by structure (light, polarized, micro-CT, SEM), composition (FTIR, TGA, BMD) and mechanics (3-point bending, microindentation): it is built from dermal osteonal and parallel-fibered bone, highly organized and tough, suited to both locomotion and protection, with an interconnected neurovascular canal network. Micro-CT data were segmented in Dragonfly 2022.2 (Segment Wizard training plus manual refinement) to mesh the canal network and measure diameters, the Bone Wizard gave spine and beam porosity, and osteocyte lacunae were segmented. (A companion to the same team's FIB-SEM paper listed on Oct 24.)

entries.title: 用分层成像、倾斜射线照相和缺陷自动识别对玻璃基板及玻璃通孔做 X 射线检测
entries.title_en: X-ray inspection of glass substrates and through-glass vias using laminography, tilted radiography, and automated defect recognition
entries.summary: D. Stickler 与 K. Hormann 的应用研究比较了 2D 射线照相、倾斜射线照相（2.5D）和计算分层成像（3DCL）在玻璃基板与玻璃通孔（TGV）检测中的表现，讨论束能量、放大倍率、成像几何和探测器特性对缺孔、残留玻璃、微裂纹、空洞、金属化不完整和分层等缺陷可见度的影响。摘要指出，文中还讨论了在 Dragonfly 3D World 中做分割以及缺陷自动识别流程，用于缺陷的规模化定位与定量。
entries.summary_en: An application study by D. Stickler and K. Hormann compares 2D radiography, tilted radiography (2.5D) and computed laminography (3DCL) for inspecting glass substrates and through-glass vias (TGVs), examining how beam energy, magnification, geometry and detector characteristics affect visibility of defects such as missing holes, residual glass, micro-cracks, voids, incomplete metallization and delamination. Per the abstract, segmentation in Dragonfly 3D World and automated defect recognition workflows are discussed for scalable defect localization and quantification.

entries.title: 俄罗斯鲟胸鳍棘层状骨的纳米尺度表征：三维 FIB-SEM 研究
entries.title_en: Nanoscale Characterization of Microscopically Layered Bone in the Russian Sturgeon Pectoral Fin Spine: A 3D FIB-SEM Study
entries.summary: 希伯来大学兽医学院团队用 Zeiss Crossbeam 540 FIB-SEM（像素约 10 nm）对俄罗斯鲟（Huso gueldenstaedtii）胸鳍棘的骨单位骨和外周骨做三维成像。图像堆栈导入 Dragonfly 3D World 2022.2 做漂移校正；随后在 Dragonfly 的 Segmentation Wizard 中训练 2D U-Net 模型分割胶原纤维与孔隙，用 Segmentation Comparator 评估（Dice 0.56–0.66），再按特征向量（Eigenvector）各向异性分析绘制钙化胶原纤维束取向图，并对孔隙做 6-连通组件、厚度网格和骨架分析。结果显示：皮质骨单位中纤维取向呈顺/逆时针“扇形”交替，符合板层骨；外周骨虽低倍下看似分层，纳米尺度却以沿棘长轴的单向纤维为主，属平行纤维骨，并伴有成群的孔隙结构。
entries.summary_en: A Hebrew University veterinary team imaged osteonal and peripheral bone of the Russian sturgeon (Huso gueldenstaedtii) pectoral fin spine with a Zeiss Crossbeam 540 FIB-SEM (~10 nm pixels). Stacks were drift-corrected in Dragonfly 3D World 2022.2, then segmented with a 2D U-Net trained in Dragonfly's Segmentation Wizard (evaluated with the Segmentation Comparator, Dice 0.56–0.66); Eigenvector-based anisotropy analysis mapped calcified collagen fibril bundle orientation, and voids were analysed with 6-connected components, thickness meshes and skeleton graphs. Dermal osteons show clockwise–anticlockwise fanning consistent with lamellar bone, while the peripheral bone, layered-looking at low magnification, is mainly unidirectional parallel-fibered bone with grouped voids.

entries.title: 用于冷冻光电关联显微（cryo-CLEM）的荧光生物传感器
entries.title_en: Fluorescent Biosensors for Cryogenic Correlative Light and Electron Microscopy
entries.summary: 斯坦福大学/SLAC 等团队把钙、pH 和渗透压荧光生物传感器引入冷冻光电关联显微流程，先在低温下标定传感器，再分别用于酿酒酵母、人 U2OS 细胞和细菌 Halothiobacillus neapolitanus。冷冻电子断层（cryo-ET）重建的断层图在 Dragonfly（v2024.1）中用自训练神经网络分割核糖体、细胞壁、羧酶体外壳与内腔，并在 Dragonfly 中手动清理后用 ChimeraX 可视化，把局部生理状态与原位三维结构联系起来。
entries.summary_en: Stanford/SLAC-led researchers bring calcium, pH and osmotic-stress fluorescent biosensors into a cryo-CLEM workflow, calibrating them under cryogenic conditions and applying them in Saccharomyces cerevisiae, human U2OS cells and the bacterium Halothiobacillus neapolitanus. Cryo-ET tomograms were segmented in Dragonfly (v2024.1) with a custom-trained neural network (ribosomes, cell wall, carboxysome shells and lumen), manually cleaned in Dragonfly and visualised in ChimeraX, linking local physiology to in situ 3D structure.

entries.title: 大西洋热液喷口两种新腹足类共生体：对内共生的依赖程度不同
entries.title_en: Two New Gastropod Holobionts from Atlantic Hydrothermal Vents Showing Different Levels of Endosymbiosis Dependence
entries.summary: Ifremer 等团队研究大西洋中脊热液喷口的两种 Peltospira 螺（P. gargantua 与 P. smaragdina）及其 Sulfurimonas 胞内共生菌。P. smaragdina 标本经 PTA 染色后在法国 SOLEIL 同步辐射 ANATOMIX 线站做 μCT 扫描（体素 3.09 μm / 1.3 μm），重建体数据导入 Dragonfly v2022.2 做预处理、分割与三维重建渲染，再与已发表的 P. gargantua 模型比较。结果显示 P. gargantua 食道腺和心室相对更大、齿舌退化，对共生依赖更强；P. smaragdina 食道腺较小、摄食器官较大，可能为混合营养。
entries.summary_en: Teams led by Ifremer characterise two Mid-Atlantic Ridge vent snails, Peltospira gargantua and P. smaragdina, and their intracellular Sulfurimonas symbionts. A PTA-stained P. smaragdina specimen was scanned by synchrotron μCT at SOLEIL's ANATOMIX beamline (3.09 μm / 1.3 μm voxels); the reconstructed volumes were pre-processed, segmented and 3D-rendered in Dragonfly v2022.2, then compared with a published P. gargantua model. P. gargantua has a proportionally larger oesophageal gland and ventricle with a reduced radula, indicating stronger symbiont dependence, while P. smaragdina's smaller gland and larger feeding apparatus point to mixotrophy.

entries.title: 官方正式发布：Dragonfly 3D World 2027
entries.title_en: Officially Released: Dragonfly 3D World 2027
entries.summary: 官方博客宣布 Dragonfly 3D World 2027 正式发布，版本 2027.1 是迄今功能最全面的一次更新：基于 Meta SAM 的 Grid-Based SAM 全自动实例分割、增强的 Cellpose-SAM 集成、2.5D/3D 图像分类、Fast Split 与 Smart Erode 秒级分离粘连物体；全新的 Subvoxel Multi-Mesh 支持亚体素精度的单个部件识别、测量与表征，孔隙定量可重复；基于 ISO 标准的表面粗糙度分析可直接从 CT 网格评价表面纹理；网格布尔运算、CAD 导入与扫描到 CAD 自动配准；软件内置 Report Builder 报告生成器（PDF/HTML 导出，完整版可导出 Word）；免费独立的 Session Viewer 让无许可证的同事也能交互浏览 3D 结果。授权策略同步调整：学术版继续免费，Subvoxel Multi-Mesh、表面粗糙度分析等新能力为完整版专属。
entries.summary_en: The official blog announces Dragonfly 3D World 2027: version 2027.1 is one of the software's most comprehensive releases yet, featuring Grid-Based SAM automated instance segmentation, enhanced Cellpose-SAM integration, 2.5D/3D image classification, and Fast Split / Smart Erode for separating touching objects in seconds; the new Subvoxel Multi-Mesh for identifying, measuring, and characterizing individual components at subvoxel resolution with repeatable porosity quantification; ISO-based Surface Roughness Analysis directly from CT-derived meshes; mesh Boolean operations, CAD import, and automatic scan-to-CAD registration; the built-in Report Builder (PDF/HTML export, Word export for Full License users); and the free standalone Session Viewer for sharing interactive 3D results with colleagues who have no license. Licensing is updated in parallel: the Academic License remains free, while Subvoxel Multi-Mesh and Surface Roughness Analysis are exclusive to the Full License.

entries.title: micro-CT 揭秘中生代甲虫：巴西 Crato 组发现新科 Cratocupedidae
entries.title_en: Unearthing Mesozoic Beetles via Micro-CT: New Family Cratocupedidae from Brazil's Crato Formation
entries.summary: 研究团队对巴西下白垩统 Crato 组保存的古甲虫化石做显微 CT 扫描，在 Dragonfly 3D World 2025.1 中完成三维重建，可视化了被沉积物基质掩盖的精细形态。基于简约法与贝叶斯推断的系统发育分析支持建立新灭绝科 Cratocupedidae，同时报道了 Ommatidae 科与 Notocupes 属在冈瓦纳大陆西部的首次记录，填补了中生代甲虫演化拼图的重要空白。
entries.summary_en: The team micro-CT-scanned fossil beetles from the Lower Cretaceous Crato Formation of Brazil, completing 3D reconstructions in Dragonfly 3D World 2025.1 to visualize fine details hidden by the sediment matrix. Phylogenetic analyses (parsimony and Bayesian inference) support erecting the new extinct family Cratocupedidae, along with the first records of Ommatidae and Notocupes from western Gondwana, filling a major gap in the Mesozoic beetle evolution puzzle.

entries.title: Micro-CT 扫描足迹：无损探索体积性足迹形成过程
entries.title_en: Micro-CT Scanning Tracks: A Means for Non-Destructively Exploring Volumetric Track Formation
entries.summary: 通过 Bruker Skyscan 1273 对两种底质（松软/极松软）下的压痕模拟实验做显微 CT 扫描（130 kV、92 μm 分辨率，约 30 分钟，特意控制时长以防沉积物水分蒸发），在 Dragonfly 3D World 2025.1 中用阈值分割划分黏土与砂区、用手动涂刷工具划分“足部”感兴趣区，实现了体积性足迹形成过程的无损三维可视化，为沉积过程研究提供了新方法。
entries.summary_en: The authors micro-CT-scanned indentation experiments in two substrate consistencies (soft / very soft) with a Bruker Skyscan 1273 (130 kV, 92 μm resolution, ~30 min, deliberately kept short to prevent sediment moisture evaporation) and segmented clay, sand, and 'foot' ROIs in Dragonfly 3D World 2025.1 using intensity-based thresholding and the manual paint tool, achieving non-destructive 3D visualization of volumetric track formation.

entries.title: 重组人 SLPI 表面功能化：促进钛种植体早期骨结合与生物力学固定
entries.title_en: Recombinant Human SLPI Surface Functionalization Enhances Early Osseointegration and Biomechanical Fixation of Titanium Implants
entries.summary: 研究团队用重组人分泌型白细胞蛋白酶抑制剂（SLPI）对钛种植体表面做功能化涂层，micro-CT 扫描种植体周围新生骨并在 Dragonfly 3D World 中定量骨体积分数（%BV/TV）：植入 4 周时 SLPI 组为百分之二十点六四，显著高于未处理钛对照组的百分之十一点七三（接近两倍）；8 周时两组骨量均升高但差异消失，说明涂层主要加速早期骨结合。组织形态学证实涂层组新生骨更多更连续；心肌肌钙蛋白 I 无显著升高，涂层安全性良好。
entries.summary_en: The team functionalized titanium implant surfaces with recombinant human SLPI (secretory leukocyte protease inhibitor) and quantified peri-implant new bone via micro-CT, with %BV/TV analyzed in Dragonfly 3D World: at 4 weeks postimplantation the SLPI group reached 20.64%, significantly higher than the untreated titanium control at 11.73% (nearly double); by 8 weeks both groups had risen and the difference disappeared, indicating the coating mainly accelerates early osseointegration. Histomorphology confirmed more continuous new bone in the coated group; cardiac troponin I showed no significant elevation, confirming coating safety.

entries.title: 官方新版应用详解：Dragonfly 3D World 2027 汽车工业 CT 检测
entries.title_en: What's New in Dragonfly 3D World 2027 for Automotive CT Inspection
entries.summary: 官方博文详解了 Dragonfly 3D World 2027 面向汽车工业 CT 检测的新能力：基于 Meta SAM 的 AI 实例分割可一键分离气孔、夹杂、焊缝缺陷与电池颗粒；Subvoxel Multi-Mesh 提供亚体素精度的可重复孔隙定量；新增网格与 CAD 互操作工具（含布尔运算与 STEP 导入）、Report Builder 报告生成器，以及 GPU 加速的 Fast Split / Smart Erode 秒级分离粘连物体。产品经理 Zixiong Cao 强调新实例分割工作流让用户几乎无需数据准备即可开始识别与测量目标。
entries.summary_en: The official post details Dragonfly 3D World 2027's capabilities for automotive CT inspection: SAM-based AI instance segmentation that separates pores, inclusions, weld defects, and battery particles with a single click; Subvoxel Multi-Mesh for repeatable, subvoxel-accurate porosity quantification; new mesh and CAD interoperability tools (Boolean operations, STEP import); the Report Builder; and GPU-accelerated Fast Split / Smart Erode that separates touching objects in seconds. Product Manager Zixiong Cao notes the new instance segmentation workflow lets users begin identifying and measuring objects almost immediately, with minimal data preparation.

entries.title: AZoM 报道：Dragonfly 3D World 2027 正式发布
entries.title_en: AZoM: Dragonfly 3D World 2027 Officially Released
entries.summary: Comet Technologies Canada 宣布 Dragonfly 3D World 2027（2027.1 版本）正式发布，官方称之为该软件迄今最全面的版本之一：AI 分割方面新增基于网格的 SAM 自动实例分割与增强的 Cellpose-SAM 集成，另有新的 2.5D/3D 图像分类以及 Fast Split、Smart Erode 分割工具；测量与分析方面新增亚体素多重网格孔隙分析、基于 ISO 标准的三维表面粗糙度分析，以及布尔运算、CAD 导入、自动网格配准等网格与 CAD 工具，内置 Report Builder 可直接导出 PDF/HTML 报告，Session Viewer 首次作为免费独立下载提供。该版本同时调整授权策略：亚体素多重网格、表面粗糙度分析、增强报告功能等为完整许可证（Full License）专属，学术许可证项目继续面向学术研究免费。
entries.summary_en: Comet Technologies Canada has announced the official release of Dragonfly 3D World 2027 (version 2027.1), described as one of the software's most comprehensive releases yet: AI segmentation gains grid-based SAM automated instance segmentation and an enhanced Cellpose-SAM integration, alongside new 2.5D/3D image classification plus Fast Split and Smart Erode tools; measurement and analysis gain subvoxel multi-mesh porosity analysis, ISO-based 3D surface roughness analysis, and mesh/CAD tools including Boolean operations, CAD import and automatic mesh registration, while the built-in Report Builder exports PDF/HTML reports and Session Viewer is available for the first time as a free standalone download. The release also updates licensing: subvoxel multi-mesh, surface roughness analysis and advanced reporting are exclusive to Full Licenses, while the Academic License program remains free for academic research.

entries.title: ISTFA 2026 论文：在 Dragonfly 3D World 中实现 X 射线 CT 数据的数字矫形与分层可视化
entries.title_en: ISTFA 2026 Paper: Digital De-warping of X-ray CT Data for Layer-Aligned Visualization, Implemented in Dragonfly 3D World
entries.summary: 先进微电子封装的翘曲会在 X 射线 CT 数据中引入几何畸变，导致各层混叠、难以判读。本研究在 Dragonfly 3D World 软件中实现了一套数字矫形工作流：基于径向基函数（RBF）的曲面拟合生成形变场，再对体数据做体积变换，得到平面化的 CT 数据以便逐层对齐分析。以倒装芯片针栅阵列（FCPGA）封装为例，该工作流显著改善了各封装层的分离与判读效果。
entries.summary_en: Warpage in advanced microelectronic packages introduces geometric distortion in X-ray CT datasets, mixing layers and limiting interpretability. This work implements a digital de-warping workflow in Dragonfly 3D World software: radial-basis-function (RBF) surface fitting generates a deformation field that is applied to the volume, producing planarized CT data for layer-aligned analysis. Demonstrated on flip-chip pin grid array (FCPGA) packages, the workflow markedly improves isolation and interpretation of individual package layers.

entries.title: PLOS Biology：Atlastin-2 介导的内质网膜系留对黄病毒复制至关重要
entries.title_en: PLOS Biology: Atlastin-2-Mediated ER Membrane Tethering Is Critical for Flavivirus Replication
entries.summary: 黄病毒（登革、寨卡等）每年造成约四亿人感染，其基因组复制依赖宿主内质网中的病毒复制细胞器（vRO）。本研究发现 Atlastin-2 介导的内质网膜系留是 vRO 形成与黄病毒复制的关键机制。作者结合电子断层成像，在 Dragonfly 3D World 软件（Comet Technologies Canada）中对 vRO 进行了人工分割与三维重构，以解析膜重塑结构。
entries.summary_en: Flaviviruses (dengue, Zika and relatives) cause roughly 400 million human infections per year, replicating inside viral replication organelles (vROs) derived from host endoplasmic reticulum. The study shows Atlastin-2-mediated ER membrane tethering is critical for vRO biogenesis and flavivirus replication. Using electron tomography, the authors manually segmented and reconstructed vROs in 3D with Dragonfly 3D World software (Comet Technologies Canada) to characterize the membrane-remodeling structures.

entries.title: Inspect Award 2026：Dragonfly 3D World 获人工智能类别第二名
entries.title_en: Inspect Award 2026: Dragonfly 3D World Takes 2nd Place in the Artificial Intelligence Category
entries.summary: 工业图像处理与光学测量领域权威奖项 Inspect Award 2026 名单揭晓：Dragonfly 3D World 在人工智能类别中获得第二名。奖项由 inspect 杂志读者与专家评审团从 40 个提名产品中评选，颁奖仪式于 10 月 6 日在斯图加特 Vision 2026 展会上举行。评委会称，该软件支持复杂二维、三维与四维图像数据的分析评估，集成深度学习能力，服务工业检测与分析任务。
entries.summary_en: The winners of Inspect Award 2026, one of the most prestigious accolades for industrial image processing and optical metrology, were honored at the Vision 2026 trade show in Stuttgart, with Dragonfly 3D World taking second place in the Artificial Intelligence category. Selected by inspect readers together with an expert jury from 40 nominated products, the software was recognized for its analysis and evaluation of complex 2D, 3D and 4D image data with integrated deep-learning capabilities for industrial inspection.

entries.title: 官方新功能视频：Dragonfly 3D World 2027「与坐标系对齐」
entries.title_en: Official feature video: Alignment with Coordinate Systems in Dragonfly 3D World 2027
entries.summary: 官方「What's new in Dragonfly 3D World 2027」系列再添新片，聚焦 2027 版改进的计量（metrology）功能：与坐标系对齐（Alignment with Coordinate Systems）。2027 版带来更精确、可重复的表面测量、更快的分割与更智能的分类工具，以及新的报告与协作方式，该视频演示了如何通过坐标系对齐实现精确的几何测量。
entries.summary_en: The official "What's new in Dragonfly 3D World 2027" series adds a new video on the release's improved metrology features: Alignment with Coordinate Systems. The 2027 release promises precise and repeatable surface measurements, faster segmentation, smarter classification tools, and new ways of reporting and collaborating; this video demonstrates how coordinate-system alignment supports precise geometric measurement.

entries.title: 官方新功能视频：Dragonfly 3D World 2027「自动网格配准」
entries.title_en: Official feature video: Automatic Mesh Registration in Dragonfly 3D World 2027
entries.summary: 官方「What's new in Dragonfly 3D World 2027」系列的另一支新视频，演示 2027 版的自动网格配准（Automatic Mesh Registration）功能。作为 2027 版增强的网格与测量工具组合的一部分，该功能让多扫描、多时点或 CAD 与实测网格之间的配准更快、更可重复，是计量与质量检测工作流的重要补充。
entries.summary_en: Another new video in the official "What's new in Dragonfly 3D World 2027" series, demonstrating Automatic Mesh Registration in the 2027 release. Part of the expanded mesh and measurement toolkit, the feature makes registering multiple scans, time points, or CAD-vs-measured meshes faster and more repeatable — a valuable addition to metrology and quality-inspection workflows.

entries.title: 官方网络研讨会录像上线：Dragonfly 3D World 2027 新功能速览（9 月 23 日场）
entries.title_en: Official webinar recording: What's new in Dragonfly 3D World 2027 (September 2026)
entries.summary: 9 月 23 日举办的「Dragonfly 3D World 2027 新功能」网络研讨会完整录像已在官方 YouTube 频道上线。研讨会围绕多孔材料分析、复杂数据分割与可复用研究工作流，讲解新一代 3D World 的最新功能，错过直播的观众现可随时回看。
entries.summary_en: The full recording of the September 23, 2026 webinar on Dragonfly 3D World 2027's new features is now available on the official Dragonfly YouTube channel. Covering porous-material analysis, complex-dataset segmentation, and repeatable research workflows, the session walks through the highlights of the next-generation 3D World for anyone who missed the live event.

entries.title: 官方研究亮点：3D 电子显微镜揭示甲藻染色体的多样形态（FIB-SEM 研究）
entries.title_en: Official Publication Spotlight: 3D Electron Microscopy Reveals Diverse Chromosome Morphologies Across Dinoflagellate Species
entries.summary: Dragonfly 官网新增研究亮点，推介一篇 bioRxiv 预印本（Lucas Philipp 等，2026 年 8 月）：研究团队用 3D FIB-SEM 分析了 8 种甲藻共 21 个细胞核、2138 条染色体的三维组织，发现各物种染色体形态差异显著（椭球体、棒状、新月形、不规则形及部分螺旋形），F. kawagutii 呈现互联的染色体网络，并在核内首次观察到疑似含 DNA 的环形结构。在 Dragonfly 3D World 中完成了大型 FIB-SEM 数据的 3D 拼接、切片配准、去条纹与平滑处理；通过手动标注切片生成深度学习训练数据，为每个细胞核单独训练 U-Net 模型并应用于整个图像栈；还用 Python 控制台定制了自动裁剪导出单个染色体、分析表面纹脊以及 Voronoi 空间分布模拟等工作流程。预印本 DOI: 10.64898/2026.08.10.743404。
entries.summary_en: The official Dragonfly site spotlights a new bioRxiv preprint (Lucas Philipp et al., August 2026): the team used 3D FIB-SEM to analyze chromosome 3D organization in 21 nuclei (2,138 chromosomes) across 8 dinoflagellate species, finding strikingly diverse chromosome morphologies (ellipsoidal, rod-shaped, crescent, irregular, partially helical); F. kawagutii shows an interconnected chromosome network, and suspected DNA-containing toroidal structures were observed inside nuclei for the first time. In Dragonfly 3D World the team performed 3D stitching, slice registration, destriping and smoothing of the large FIB-SEM datasets; generated deep-learning training data by manual slice annotation, trained a dedicated U-Net model per nucleus and applied it to whole stacks; and built custom Python-console workflows such as auto-cropping and exporting individual chromosomes for surface-ridge analysis and Voronoi spatial-distribution simulations. Preprint DOI: 10.64898/2026.08.10.743404.

entries.title: 官方研究亮点：鼻黏膜疫苗与免疫细胞早期互作的 3D 超微结构（FIB-SEM 研究）
entries.title_en: Official Publication Spotlight: Visualizing Early Mucosal Vaccine–Immune Cell Interactions in 3D Ultrastructure
entries.summary: Dragonfly 官网新增研究亮点，推介发表于 npj Vaccines 的论文（Kanwal 等，荷兰 Radboudumc，2026;11:105）：研究团队在小鼠鼻内接种 OMV 基肺炎链球菌疫苗候选物后 1–72 小时追踪疫苗分布与免疫应答，结合 Airyscan 荧光显微、关联光电显微（CLEM）与体积 FIB-SEM（1284 张图像、每切 5 纳米），发现中性粒细胞是鼻组织中与疫苗颗粒互作的主要免疫细胞。在 Dragonfly 3D World 中，研究人员将分割数据导入进行 3D 可视化处理，把细胞膜、细胞核、囊泡等结构转化为独立 3D 对象并叠加疫苗相关荧光信号，探索完整成像体积内的空间关系，相关结果呈现在论文图 7 中。DOI: 10.1038/s41541-026-01430-y。
